tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal kye rdo rje'i byung tshul dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal kye rdo rje'i byung tshul dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus par phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi gsung gi nyin byed 'od zer gyis// bdag blo'i snying gi mun pa kun bsal nas// ma nor chos don dri med ston mdzad pa'i// rtog med mtshan can dpal ldan bla mas skyong*// rdo rje 'chang dbang gsung ngag bdud rtsi'i rgyun// zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa'i man ngag gis// rgyud don zab mo'i dgongs pa gsal mdzad pa// sa skya'i bla chen rnams la bdag cag dad// rgyud rnams kun gyi yang dag nges pa'i don// gsang chen rnal 'byor gnyis su med pa'i rgyud// rdo rje'i tshig gyur bdun brgya lnga bcu pa'i// byung tshul brgyud pa'i rnam thar 'dir bshad bya// 'dir rdo rje theg pa'i byung tshul rnam par bzhag pa la/ spyi don gnyis pa theg pa chen po thun mong ma yin pa'i 'dod tshul gtan la dbab pa la gsum/ rdo rje theg pa spyi yi byung tshul/ rgyud 'di nyid kyi byung tshul/ byung ba'i chos la 'chad nyan bya tshul lo// dang po la sangs rgyas sangs rgyas pa'i dus nam yin pa sogs spyi rnam ltar ro// gnyis pa la gsum/ ston pas gsung tshul/ sdud pa pos bsdus tshul/ de ji ltar 'phel ba'i tshul lo// dang po la gnyis/ spyir ston pa chos kyi sku yis gsung tshul dang*/ bye brag tu longs sprul gnyis kyis gsung tshul lo// dang po ni/ ston pa chos kyi sku'i bzhugs pa'i gnas ni/ dpyad par bya ba bden pa gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad la/ dpyod byed lhag mthong so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad nas/

dpyad pa'i chos sku nyid thams cad du snang zhing thim pa'i tshul gyis khyab par bzhugs te/ mdor na bzhugs par bya ba'i gnas bden pa gnyis kyi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad la'o// bzhugs pa po ston pa ni bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje thugs yang dag pa'i ye shes bsgrub bya'i rig pa chos kyi sku rang byung gi ye shes chen po zhes bya ba des/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyi chos nyid rang bzhin gyi chos sku dang*/ ji lta ba bzhin du mngon du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs rtogs pa chos kyi sku'i ye shes dang gnyis su med pa'i chos nyid do// bzhugs pa'i tshul/ chos kyi sku de kun rdzob tu chos thams cad du snang bas na/ de las byung ba'i tshul gyis khyab cing bzhugs la/ don dam pa dag pa dang*/ ma dag pa'i chos te/ de bzhin nyid du thim zhing 'gro bas na bdag nyid gcig pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs so// dus ni/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du mi 'gyur bar rtag tu bzhugs shing*/ 'khor dang chos ni ston pa de nyid kyi rnam 'phrul te/ don dam par na phun sum tshogs pa lnga tha dad du grub pa med de/ rdo rje gur las/ 'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das// lha yi bdag po gcig pu nyid// thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs// zhes dang*/ de'i 'grel par/ 'di ni zhes bya ba ni/ 'dis ni rtag tu da ltar 'byung ba'o// rang byung zhes bya ba ni/ don dam par rgyu la sogs pa med pa'i phyir ro// bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba la/ bha ga ni dbang phyug la sogs pa drug ste/ de 'di la yod pas bcom ldan 'das so// de skad du/ dbang phyug dang ni gzugs bzang dang*// dpal dang grags dang ye shes dang*// brtsams pa phun sum tshogs ldan pa// drug po 'di dag bcom par bshad// ces sogs gsungs/ gcig pu zhes bya ba ni gnyis su med pa ste/ chos sku'i tshul gyis so// zhes dang*/ sam+bu ṭa las/ rang byung ngo bo 'di nyid ni// chos kyi sku zhes rab tu grags// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa la gnyis/

longs sku rgyu'i he ru kas gsung tshul dang*/ sprul sku 'bras bu'i he ru kas gsung tshul lo// dang po ni/ gnas nges pa 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing du/ ngo bo nges pa zla ba chu shel nor bu'i 'od can gyi rdo rje 'chang chen po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pas/ 'khor nges pa rdo rje snying po la sogs pa sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ chos nges pa dpal kye rdo rje'i rgyud rnams dus nges par rgyun mi chad du gsungs pa yin te/ ji skad du/ gang yang 'og min zhing khams ni// ye shes snang ba rgyas pa'i phyir// bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang chen gyis// rgyun mi chad cing khyab pa dang*// rtag cing 'gyur med mchog gis ni// gsang chen 'di ni kun tu ston// zhes gsungs so// de'ang longs sku la 'das grongs mi mnga' bar sa bcu'i byang sems kyi dbus su/ theg chen gyi chos la rdzogs par longs spyod pa'i snang ba rgyun mi chad pa'i phyir rtag pa zhes bya'i/ 'gyur med kyi rtag brtan du 'dod pa ni ma yin te/ slob dpon lha'i rigs kyi blo gros kyis/ chos kyi sku ni rang bzhin rtag pa'o// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni 'khor mor bzhugs pas rtag pa'o// sprul pa'i sku ni rgyun mi chad pas rtag pa'o// zhes gur 'grel du gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la bzhi/ dang por sprul sku mchog gis gsung tshul/ phyis shākya seng ges bzlas te gsung tshul// bzlas te gsungs pa'i dgos pa/ de la rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ gsung pa'i rgyu dang*/ tshul ji ltar gsungs pa'o// dang po ni/ dzam+bu'i gling 'dir dbang phyug la sogs pa 'jig rten pa chen po rnams 'dul ba'i phyir gsungs te/ de'ang rgyud rgyas pa las 'byung ba'i don/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis gsungs bzhin bshad na/ sngon khams gsum las/ gzugs med pa'i khams la ni bdag po med la/

gzugs khams kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang*/ 'dod khams rgya che ba'i bdag po dbang phyug chen po dang*/ 'dod khams rgya chung ba'i bdag po gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdud sdig to can dang*/ ri rab kyi rtse man chad gling bzhi'i bdag po/ dbang ldan na gnas pa'i drag po dbang phyug chen po ste gtso bo bzhi dang*/ de dag gi chung ma gau rī la sogs pa brgyad 'khor 'dod khams kyi tshangs pa la sogs pa dregs pa can brgyad dang*/ de dag la yang rang gi 'khor dang chung ma la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa rnams 'dod chags shas che bas/ spyod lam dus bzhir chung ma dang 'khyud/ zhe sdang shas che bas mi mang po bsad nas de dag gi sha khrag la rol/ gti mug shas che bas rgyu 'bras dang de kho na'i don la rmongs/ 'dod yon lnga rang dgar spyod cing*/ dzam+bu gling gi mi thams cad dbang du bsdus nas/ rang yang las log pa la zhugs shing*/ gzhan dag kyang 'god par byed la/ dregs pa'i rlom tshig kyang smra'o// de'i tshe longs sku rgyu'i he ru kas/ drag po dbang phyug 'khor bcas 'dul ba'i phyir/ dgongs pa sna tshogs pa'i dam tshig chen pos rnam par rol pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ ba spu'i bu ga nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sna tshogs pa gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgyar gdul bya'i don du spros shing*/ khyad par du dzam+bu'i gling 'dir/ sprul sku 'bras bu'i he ru ka bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa dang*/ drag po'i chung ma brgyad dang ming mthun pa'i gau rī la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad sprul nas dbang phyug rang dang*/ de bas che ba gsum dang bcas pa bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi gdan du mdzad/ dregs pa can brgyad ni lha mo brgyad kyi gdan du byas/ zhes rnam bshad dag ldan du 'byung la/ gdan gyi dag pa las/ drag po'i 'khor che shos ni gtso bos mnan/ drag po rang ni ghasma rīs mnan no zhes bshad do// dbang phyug gi chung ma brgyad dang*/

de dag gi 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni phrin las pa'i tshul gyi dur khrod brgyad du bskrad nas de rnams kyi zhe sdang btul/ tsum+bha dang bsrub pa la sogs pa bde ba chen po'i rnam 'phrul gyis 'dod chags btul/ sngags la sogs pa gsung gi sgras gti mug btul bar mdzad de/ mdor na dbang phyug 'khor bcas kyis 'jig rten pa rnams ma rungs par byas pas/ de dag 'dul ba'i ched du'o// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar dus dbang phyug 'khor bcas btul ba'i rjes kho na la gnas rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga'i nang du tshud pa'i gzhal yas khang par ston pa bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rjes 'khor 'jig rten las 'das pa du ma la/ chos kye rdo rje 'bum phrag bdun gyi bdag nyid can gyi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dang*/ 'bum phrag lnga pa zhes bya ba rtog pa'i rgyud dang*/ de'i rgyud phyi ma dpal phyag rgya chen po thig le/ phyi ma'i phyi ma ye shes snying po/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad pa'i rgyud ye shes thig le/ rgyud sde gzhan dang thun mong gi bshad rgyud dpal sam+pu ṭa 'bum phrag sum cu so drug pa/ snying po'i rgyud grub pa nges bstan thig le/ 'bras bu'i rgyud de kho na nyid sgron me rnams gsungs te/ ye shes thig le las/ de nas gzhan nyon bdag gis bshad// ji ltar rgyud kyi rim pa bzhugs// dpal dang ldan pa'i rin chen rgyud// 'bum bdun gyis ni mtshan zhes bya// de ni gtso bo'i rtsa ba'i rgyud// sku brgyad bdag nyid rab kyi mchog /de brtag kye yi rdo rje ni// 'bum lnga yi ni mtshan zhes bya// dpal ldan phyag rgya che thig le// de yi phyi ma'i rgyud du dran// ye shes snying por grags pa'i rgyud// de yi phyi ma'i phyi ma'o// dga' mo ye shes thig le sgra// bshad pa'i rgyud ni gsang ba che// grub pa nges bstan thig le ni// zhal bzang mo de snying po dang*// de kho na nyid sgron me'i mtshan// 'bras bu'i rgyud grags 'chad par 'gyur// de bdun du ni bdag gis bshad// ces gsungs so// gal te 'bum phrag lnga pa la sogs pa'i rgyud rnams shākya thub pa'i sngon rol du gsungs pa gang gis shes zhe na/

mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud rtsa 'grel las/ rgyud chen po mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la sogs pa 'dir 'dus pa'i gzugs 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa drug gis rtsa ba'i mdo rnam par 'chad pa por gyur to// rgya che ba ni du ma'o// mdor bsdus pa stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi ni chos kyi phung po'i tshad de 'di ni nges pa'o// 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa drug gi rgyud rgya chen po de'i dbus nas yongs su bsdus pa'i gzugs snying po lta bu chung ngu mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho de ltar 'di'i ming du bshad pa'o// ri rab rdul zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyun chad med par rab tu 'bab pa ste/ de bzhin du bshad do// slar yang rtsod pa'i dus su rgyud chen por mngon par brjod pa 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa drug pa shākya seng ges gsungs so// de'i nang nas slar yang rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa'i ma mo 'dus pa rnams kyis rgyud 'di rdo rje'i gnas su bcom ldan 'das las thos pas/ phan tshun rjes su bstan par byas nas bsdu bar mdzad pa ste/ gang bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa de la mngon par dga' ba ste/ tshig 'di la zhes bya ba ni gzhung gi tshad la yang ngo*// lhag ma gzhan pa'i sems can rnams grol zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni rab tu gsungs pas so// rnal 'byor zhes bya ba ni rnal 'byor rgya mtsho'o// ye shes zhes bya ba ni ye shes rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'o// sdom pa zhes bya ba ni sdom pa rgya mtsho'o// bya ba zhes bya ba ni bya ba rgya mtsho'o// de kho na nyid ces bya ba ni de kho na nyid rgya mtsho'o// 'di rnams zhes bya ba ni rgyud lnga po 'di rnams la mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di gtso bo ste/ rgyud kyi rgyal po rgyud lnga dang mnyam pa rgya mtsho zhes drug po mdor bsdus pa rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan gyi ming can no// zhes rnal 'byor rgya mtsho dang*/ ye shes rgya mtsho la sogs pa rgyud gzhan lnga dang*/

de lnga char dang mnyam pa'i mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud 'bum phrag sum cu so drug pa ste/ rgyud drug po de rnams ni/ shākya thub pa'i sngon rol du gsungs par bshad la/ ye shes rgya mtsho'i rgyud ni 'bum phrag lnga pa yin te/ phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ ye shes rgya mtsho kye rdo rje// 'bum phrag lnga yi bdag nyid rgyud// gang zhig khyod kyis de nyid gsungs// zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro// gal te rtsod dus su'ang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho 'bum phrag gsum cu so drug po gsungs par bshad do zhe na/ de ni rgyud chen por mngon par brjod pa zhes bya ba yin gyi/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho ni ma yin no// 'o na da lta'i mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i bsdus rgyud 'di de las phyung ba yin pa'i phyir/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho zhes pa'i mtshan mi 'thad par thal ba'i skyon yod do zhe na/ med de dper na/ kye rdor 'bum lnga las brtag gnyis phyung ba yin kyang*/ brtag gnyis la 'bum lnga zhes pa'i mtshan med pa bzhin no// des na 'bum phrag bdun pa ni/ 'bum lnga'i rtsa rgyud du bshad pa'i phyir thog mar gsungs par grub cing*/ phyag rgya chen po thig le ni/ rtsa rgyud 'bum phrag lnga bstan ma thag pa'i rjes su gzhan ma yin pa'i 'khor gyi dbus su gsungs so// zhes 'grel par bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ ye shes thig le ni bshad rgyud yin la/ rtsa rgyud nam gsungs pa'i tshe/ bshad rgyud gsungs pa mi 'gal zhing*/ rgyud de nyid las/ kye bcom ldan 'das ma 'ongs pa'i dus yang dag par gsang ba'i rgyud 'di skal ba dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams la sus bshad par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dpal phyag na rdo rje mgon pos bshad par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ de kho na nyid sgron ma ni/ rgyud de nyid las/ gsang ba chen po'i rgyud 'di ni// shes pa dang ni bshad pa su// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/

byang phyogs dpal rdo rje'i gnas u rgyan du rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti zhes bya bas/ shes pa dang bshad pa dang sems can la gsal bar byed do// ces phyis gsang sngags 'byung bar lung bstan pa'i phyir/ rgyud 'di rnams thog mar gsungs pa yin no// 'o na bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba'i 'grel par bde mchog gsung tshul bshad nas/ de'i rjes su dzam+bu'i gling 'di nyid du/ ma ga dhār bdud bzhi btul ba'i don du/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud bstan pa chen po dang chung ngu'i rgyud bshad pa'i rgyud dang bcas pa bstan par mdzad do// zhes bshad pa dang 'gal zhe na mi 'gal te/ de'i rgyud chen po ni 'bum phrag bdun pa yin la/ chung ngu ni 'bum phrag lnga pa yin zhing*/ bshad pa'i rgyud ni ye shes thig le la sogs pa yin no// des na thog mar bde mchog gi chos 'khor bskor nas/ de nas dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud de rnams gsungs te/ slar yang sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud chung ngu rnams gsungs pa yin la/ bde mchog gi rgyud ni phyis gsungs pa med pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ ston pa nges don du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ gsang sngags mtha' dag gsungs nas/ slar yang dzam+bu'i gling gi mi rnams kyi phyir/ dga' ldan du dam pa tog dkar por 'khrungs pa la sogs pa mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan te/ theg pa gsum gyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ chags bral gyi lam gyis 'dul bar mi nus pa rnams kyi don du/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde bsdus pa 'ga' zhig gsungs shing*/ khyad par rtsa rgyud bsdus pa dpal kye rdo rje zhes bya ba brtag pa gnyis kyi bdag nyid can dang*/ bsdus rgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur dang*/ rgyud gzhan dang thun mong gi bshad rgyud dpal sam+bu ṭa rnams gsungs pa las/ 'dir rtsa rgyud kyi dbang du byas na/

gnas phun sum tshogs pa rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga ni/ dka' 'grel rdo rje'i tshig btu bar/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa gsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ bha ga ces bya ba smros te ye shes kyi bdag nyid kyi phyir/ bem po ma yin pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgyan gyi khyad par gyis spras pa/ tshad med pa'i bsod nams kyi rgyu las byung ba de ni bha ga ste de na'o// 'di nyid gang yin zhe na skal ba dang ldan pa de dag la ni/ rgyal po'i khab la sogs pa tha mal pa'i gnas 'di dag nyid de ltar snang ba'o// zhes gsungs so// ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ sprul pa'i sku bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa ste/ rgyud phyi ma las/ phyag ni bcu drug zhal brgyad pa la sogs pa gsungs so// 'dir gtum ston sogs bod kyi 'grel byed kha cig sku gsung thugs snying po kye rdo rje bdag med ma/ ku ru kul+le rnams kyis gsungs par 'dod mod/ bstan pa gcig la ston pa drug 'byung ba shin tu ngo mtshar ro// 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ni rdo rje snying po la sogs pa dpa' bo'i 'khor bye ba phrag brgyad cu dang*/ bdag med la sogs pa rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor ri rab kyi rdul dang mnyam pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'gro ba rgyud yongs su dag pa lha dang mi bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa'o// dus phun sum tshogs pa ni/ dka' 'grel rdo rje'i tshig btu bar/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi sprul pa'i sku mi lo brgyad cur dzam+bu'i gling du bzhugs pa de srid la/ rgyud rin po che 'di ni yang nas yang du ma gsungs kyi/ dus gcig na lan cig gsungs pa kho na ste/ de bas na/ 'di yi dus ni dus gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa kho na'o// zhes gsungs so/ de ltar phun tshogs bzhi 'dzom pa'i tshe/ chos phun sum tshogs pa gsung bar bzhed nas/ ston pas rdo rje snying po la spyan gyis gzigs zhal 'dzum pa mdzad de/

thugs dpal gyi be'u las 'od zer phyung nas bskul bas rdo rje snying po stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ ye shes kyi dbang po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po rje btsun gsang ba las ches shin tu gsang ba'ang bstan par 'tshal na/ de rnams ji lta bu zhig lags zhes zhus pas/ e ma ho zhes pa ngo mtshar che ba'i tshig dang*/ legs so zhes gtang rag byin nas/ zhus pa dang lan gyi sgo nas brtag pa gnyis kyi bdag nyid le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum/ sh+lau ka bdun brgya lnga bcu pa'i rgyud 'di gsungs pa dang*/ de bzhin du nam mkhar bem bcas dwang ba dang*/ zhes sogs kyis bsdus rgyud dam thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gsungs pa dang*/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus zhes sogs kyis rgyud gzhan dang thun mong gi bshad rgyud dpal yang dag par sbyor ba rnams gsungs te/ 'di dag kyang drang don du dus rim can du gsungs par mngon no// gsum pa ni/ ma 'ongs pa'i gang zag shes rab chung zhing tshe thung ba/ dbang po rtul ba rnams kyis rtsa rgyud chen po rnams gzung bar mi nus pas/ de dag gi don du rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud bsdus pa rnams gsungs pa yin te// rdo rje gur las/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na spros pa las bsdus pa lags/ bskal pa bzang po las byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ so so skye bo tshe thung bar 'gyur na ji ltar na de rnams 'dzin par 'gyur/ ji ltar na de rnams thos par 'gyur/ ji ltar na sems par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na skye bo phal pa tshe thung bar 'gyur/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ re zhig gang dag slob dpon du gyur pa de rnams rtsa ba'i ltung bar 'gyur ba dang*/ gang dag spyod pa po de rnams mi dge bcu'i las kyi lam la spyod par 'gyur ba dang*/

gang dag so so skye bo de dag srog chags gsod par 'gyur ba dang*/ gang dag ma mo'i tshogs rnams gcig tu 'dod pa la zhen par 'gyur ba ste/ de'i phyir na rgyud rnams kyi bstan pa rgyas pa ma yin no// zhes gsungs shing*/ de'i don yang*/ slob dpon shān+ti pas/ de bas na bsam gtan gyi bdud rtsi'i ro ma myong bas/ thos pa dang bsam pa'i shes rab tsam la chags bzhin du 'chi ba'i dus byed par ma gyur cig snyam du dgongs pas ched du gzhung rgyas pa mi snang bar byin gyis brlab pa'o// zhes bshad do// kha cig rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa 'dar byed kyi gling na yod do zhes 'chad pa ni lung 'di dang 'gal lo// bzhi pa ni/ gal te de nyid kyis gdul bya rnams kyi phyir rtsa rgyud rgyas pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi phyir rtsa rgyud bsdus pa gsungs pa yin na/ rtsa rgyud bsdus pa dang por ma gsungs pa'i phyir/ phyis bzlas te gsung zhes pa mi 'thad do zhe na/ skyon med de rtsa rgyud 'di'i tshig don mtha' dag 'bum phrag lnga pa na tshang bar bzhugs pa las/ slar yang nyung ngu'i rgyud 'di logs su gsungs pa'i phyir/ phyis bzlas te gsung zhes pa nyid 'thad de// rgyas pa ni gur rgyan du shes par bya'o/ gnyis pa ni/ drang don gyi dbang du byas na/ rgyud sde rnams kyi 'grel par rang gi zhu ba po gang yin gyis bsdus par bshad pas 'dir rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ sam+pu ṭa ni rdo rje snying pos bsdus la/ rdo rje gur ni bdag med mas bsdus so// zhes bla ma dag gsungs la/ nag po pa'i 'grel chung las rdo rje snying pos bsdus par bshad do// nges don gyi dbang du byas na de ltar ston pa dang 'khor dang nyan pa dang sdud pa po tha dad du zhen cing de la mos pa'i gang zag drang ba'i don du/ ston pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul/ ston pa dang 'khor dang sdud pa po tha dad du snang bar ston pa yin gyi/

rgyud tha dad du gyur pa ma yin te/ kye rdo rje las/ 'chad po nga chos kyang nga*// rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga*// zhes gsungs pas so/ de ltar na rang las tha dad pa lta bu'i sdud pa pos bsdus par bstan pa'ang gdul bya drang ba'i don yin gyi/ yang dag par na ston pa nyid kyi e waṃ ma ya zhes sogs gsungs pa las/ dbang po rnon pos rgyud thams cad kyi don mdor bsdus nas bstan par go /rtul pos sdud pa pos gling gzhi gsungs par go ba yin gyi/ sangs rgyas kyis chos bstan pa'i dus phyis sdud pa pos bcug pa'i tshig ma yin te/ yin na rgyud ston pa pos de la bshad pa mdzad pa mi rigs pa la/ rgyud du ma las gleng gzhi'i bshad pa gsungs pa'i phyir/ ston pa nyid kyis gsungs par nges te/ gsang ba grub pa las/ slob dpon phal cher 'di skad brjod// dpal ldan 'dus pa mdangs chen gyi// rgyud kyi sdud par byed pa po// dpa' bo 'jig rten dbang phyug zer// bla ma'i zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis// dpal ldan 'dus pa sdud pa po// gzhan dag yod pa ma yin zhes// bdag nyid 'ba' zhig smra bar byed// rgyud mdzad pa ni thugs rdo rje// gsung pa po de brjod pa'ang de// de las gzhan dag yod min pas// bde chen las gzhan gsungs pa med// 'di skad bdag thos tshig gang dang*// bzhugs zhes bya ba'i tshig gnas pa// thugs kyi rdo rje bdag nyid kyi// sangs rgyas kun la bstan pa yin// zhes so// gsum pa la gnyis/ 'phags pa'i yul du 'phel tshul dang*/ de bod du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ sprul pa'i sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa la/ rgyud dang man ngag mtha' dag gdams shing*/ snyan brgyud bzhis byin gyis brlabs te/ 'di dag gi lo rgyus kyang rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa ltar shes par bya'o// slob dpon des mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug ḍom+bhi he ru ka la gdams te/

de'ang slob dpon 'di rgya gar shar phyogs bhaṃ ga lar sku 'khrungs nas/ de'i nags gseb na sgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs pa la/ yul de na grong khyer ra ḍa zhes bya ba'i tshogs pa chen po yod la/ de'i rgyal po de ha ra zhes bya bas slob dpon gyi yon bdag byas nas/ khab kyi yang thog tu spyan drangs nas bla mar bzung ste/ nyin re zhing phyag 'tshal zhing gdams ngag zhus pas/ rgyal po'i blon po rnams gros byas nas/ slob dpon gyi phyag rgya rigs ngan g.yung mo yin pas slob dpon gyi zhabs spyi bos blangs pas/ rgyal po rigs ngan du song*/ des 'bangs thams cad kyang rigs ngan du song bas/ de la dag byed kyi thabs dgos/ de'ang gzhan gang gis kyang mi dag pas slob dpon nyid mes bsreg dgos zer nas/ rgyal po la slob dpon bsreg par zhu phul bas/ der ma gnang yang blon po rnams kyis dbang med bsreg par 'dug nas/ 'di dag mi mos pa bzlog pa'i thabs shig mdzad na snyam pa la/ slob dpon gyis rgyal po'i bsam pa mkhyen nas/ stag mi zan gcig la zhon nas/ g.yung mo 'phongs su bskyon/ dug sbrul mang pos lus brgyan nas/ grong khyer du spyod pa la byon pas de dag thams cad dad par gyur to// de nas slob dpon nam mkhar gshegs pas rgyal pos bdag rjes su gzung du gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ nam mkha' nas bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi 'od gsungs shing*/ je mtho je mthor gyur nas sgrub thabs rdzogs pa dang mi snang bar gyur to// de'i tshe rgyal pos bdud rtsi 'od yi ger bkod pa yin no zhes grag go /yang lugs cig la stag la bcibs nas nags khrod du byon pa la/ yul mi rnams kyis seng ldeng la sogs pa'i shing mang po bcer nas me la bsregs pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas rgyal po la/ thal ba zhag bdun du srungs shig ces gsungs nas mes bkrongs so// de nas rgyal po nang par phyin pas// me'i phung por 'dug pa la ngu zhing bskor ba byas so// de nas me shi nas thal bar 'dug pa la zhag bdun du bskor ba byas pas/

nang par thal phung gi dkyil nas slob dpon kye rdo rje lha dgu'i rnam par byas te nam mkha' la gshegs so// der rgyal pos bdag rjes su gzung bar zhu byas pas/ sngar bzhin bdud rtsi 'od gsungs so zhes grag go /de lta bu'i slob dpon des kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs dang*/ bdag med ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*/ de nyid bcu pa la sogs pa mdzad do// des paṇ+ḍi ta a la la badz+ra la gsung ste/ des kyang kye rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs sogs mdzad do// des dpal ldan nags khrod pa chen po la gsung*/ des grub thob gar+bha ri pa la gsung*/ 'dis dran pa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs mdzad cing*/ rgyud la 'jug pa'ang mdzad do zhes grag go /slob dpon de rnams kyis kyang mchog gi dngos grub thob pa kho na yin no// des slob dpon dza ya shrī dz+nyā na zhes bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi tar gyur nas/ gsang sngags la sgrub pa mdzad cing 'tsho ba bsod snyoms la brten pas na/ rje btsun bsod snyoms pa chen por grags pa de la gsung*/ des slob dpon mi thub zla ba la gsungs te/ 'di la grub pa ma thob par bzhed pa dang*/ thob par bzhed pa gnyis las/ dang po ltar na/ slob dpon de'i rigs rgyal rigs/ yul ma ga dhā yin la/ dge 'dun phal chen sde pa la rab tu byung nas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dang*/ khyad par du rgyud sde bzhi la shin tu mkhas pas/ dpal na len+d+ra'i paṇ+ḍi tar gyur pa dang*/ thugs rgyal cher skyes te/ mi thub zla ba shi ba na gsang sngags gang du 'gro zhes gsungs pas/ de slob dpon bsod snyoms pas gsan nas/ nga yod bzhin du de skad zer ba/ khyod la las kyi sgrib pa dpag tu med pa yod pas/ de sbyang pa'i thabs la 'bad dgos zhes gsungs pa la/ ji ltar bya zhes zhus pas/ srin bu pad pa'i dong du zhag bdun bsdad dgos zhes gsungs nas bsdad pas/ shi la thug par song ste/

zhag bdun 'das pa dang*/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyod kyis sgrib pa byang ste/ dngos grub dpag tu med pa thob par 'gyur bas/ sgrub pa gyis/ gzhan don du bstan bcos mang po rtsoms shig ces gnang ba la brten nas/ rtsa rgyud la dka' 'grel ku mu ti dang*/ sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga /gur rigs bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs/ de thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzang po yongs bzung zhes bya ba rnams mdzad do// de lta bu'i slob dpon de sgrib pa sbyang dka' bas sbyang dka' zla ba dang*/ rtsod pa gzhan gyis thub dka' bas thub dka' zla ba zhes kyang zer te/ de gnyis ka yang durdza ya tsan+d+ra zhes pa'i sgra las 'byung ngo*// yang grub pa thob par bzhed pa ltar na/ slob dpon de nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul dza lan+dha ra'i gnas na sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ yul de'i phyogs gcig na dmangs phal pa cig la/ bud med mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ las rgya'i rten du rung ba cig yod la/ de dmangs phal pa cig la dga' zhing gnas pa la/ skabs shig tu gnas der mkha' 'gro ma rnams tshogs 'khor gyi rdzas bsogs pa mthong nas/ mos kyang shing tog la sogs pa khyer nas phyin pas mo yi khyo rtog pa ngan pa zhugs nas tshogs 'khor gyi rdzas bsogs pa'i sgo khang gi shing gseb tu bsdad pas/ nam phyed nas mo byung ste/ shing bu dang bcas pa khyer nas u rgyan du phyin te tshogs 'khor byas pas/ slob dpon gyis mkhyen nas// skal ba dang mi ldan pa'i mi shing rtsa'i nang du zhugs so// zhes gsungs pas thams cad kyis shes te/ shing rtsa'i mi khyod dmangs rigs/ lhan cig skyes pa'i bu mo'i gan du 'ongs pa ma legs zhes brjod cing*/ slob dpon gyis rkang mgyogs kyi sngags brjod nas skad cig la rang sar bkye/ shing yang ma nyams par rang gi sgo khang du btsugs so// der dran pa rnyed nas nga yi chung ma 'di 'dre yin par 'dug pas gsod snyam pa dang*/

slob dpon gyis de mkhyen nas rnal 'byor ma rnams la kha sbyar 'byed pa'i cho ga gsungs pas/ ma he cig yod pa de'i khong du kye rdo rje zhugs nas/ de'i rwa rtses khyo yi lte ba la brdungs te bsad do/ de nas bud med des ro khyer te/ yang tshogs 'khor la phyin pas/ ro de skye ba bdun pa'i shar song nas/ slob dpon gyi gtso byas tshogs 'khor la 'dus pa thams cad mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thob po zhes grag go /des paṇ+ḍi ta pradz+nyā in+d+ra ru tsi ra zhes bya ba/ gsang mtshan dpa' bo rdo rjer grags pa dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po dang*/ seng ge rdo rje ste slob ma'i mchog gsum la gdams pa las/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang pos/ paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra la gsungs/ dpa' bo rdo rje bod du byon te rin chen 'bar ba brtsams so// gnyis pa ni/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi tshe/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa bsgyur ro zhes 'byung yang*/ bshad bka' la sogs ma 'phel bar snang la/ dus phyis rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa 'brog mi shākya ye shes zhes bya bas rgya gar du byon nas/ mkhas pa sgo drug la pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ sngags kyi gzhung lugs thams cad mkhas pa bslabs te/ yul du 'byon khar rgya gar shar phyogs su byon nas/ dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje las/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud gsum yan lag dang bcas pa dang*/ man ngag du ma zhus te bod du byon nas/ rgyud gsum yan lag dang bcas pa'i cha mtha' dag bsgyur/ phyis paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra bod du byon pa'i tshe/ rgyud rkyang man ngag gi bshad pa dang*/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag rnams tshang bar zhus te/ thos bsam gyi sgo nas gtan la phab pa yin no// lots+tsha ba chen po des slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa la gsungs kyang*/ 'dir gzhung tshar ba'i slob ma bzhi ni/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/

se ston kun rig 'phags pa chos snang ste bzhi las mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying pos/ rtsa rgyud kyi tshig 'grel dang*/ bsdus don la sogs pa mdzad nas/ 'khon sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar la gsungs/ des rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la gdams so// yang se ston kun rig gis zhang dgon pa ba la gsungs/ de dang 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po gnyis char kyis rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la gdams so// de ltar brgyud pa'i bka' bab du ma dang ldan pa'i bla ma de nyid las/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos gsan nas/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag dang*/ rtsa rgyud dang sam+bu ṭa gnyis kyi bsdus don dang rnam bshad la sogs pa mdzad do// de las rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis gnas nas/ rgyud gsum gyi mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing dang*/ rtsa rgyud kyi rnam bshad dag ldan dang*/ rdo rje gur gyi bsdus don dang*/ rnam bshad la sogs pa mdzad do// de las chos kyi rje dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas gsan nas/ bdag med ma'i stod 'grel la sogs pa mdzad do// de las chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches gsan nas/ rtsa rgyud kyi mchan bu dang bsdus don la sogs pa mdzad do// de las bla ma dga' ldan bkra shis dpal gyis gsan nas/ rtsa rgyud kyi spyi don dang gzhung don rin po che'i sgron ma gnyis mdzad do// de las chos rje brag phug pa bsod nams dpal gyis gsan/ de las bla ma blo gros brtan pas gsan/ de las bla ma dam pa dpal ldan tshul khrims kyis gsan/ de las bdag gi bla ma thams cad mkhyen pas gsan te/ 'di ni rgyud gsum char gyi brgyud pa yin no// yang rtsa rgyud rkyang pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'gro mgon chos kyi rgyal po las bla ma 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal gyis gsan/ de las bla ma dpal ldan seng ges gsan/ de las chos kyis rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gsan/ de las bla ma dam pa dpal ldan tshul khrims kyis gsan/

de las bdag gi bla ma thams cad mkhyen pas gsan/ de las bdag gis spyir mdo sngags kyi chos du ma dang*/ khyad par du rgyud gsum gyi dbang bka' bshad bka' lung bka' rnams dang*/ dag pa gsum gyi khrid dang*/ sgo drug chos 'brel la sogs pa man ngag du ma zhus so/ gsum pa la lnga/ 'chad pa po slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ nyan pa po slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ dpon slob 'grel brtag tshul/ brtags nas 'chad nyan bya tshul/ de ltar byas pa'i 'bras bu'o// dang po ni rtsa rgyud du/ rang 'dod lha mnyam rnal 'byor pa// rab mthong sngags kyi pha rol son// zhes dang*/ rdo rje gur las/ dal zhing zab mo'i chos dang ldan// rig pa thams cad mkhas par bcas// sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor sngags shes shing*// rab gnas gtor ma'i pha rol son// de nyid bcu ni rnam par rig /nyan thos spyod pa srung ba po// sngags spyod rim par gus pa dang*// gzugs bzang mthong na dga' ba dang*// dkyil 'khor bri zhing bzlas par ldan// rtsa ba'i ltung ba 'joms pa po// sngags dang lus skyob sbyor ba yis// 'jig rten rnams ni bde bar byed// ces dang phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ dbang bskur yod dang de nyid shes// ye shes shes dang thugs rje che// yan lag rlabs chen dpa' bo dang*// ser sna med dang rang bzhin bzang*// skal ldan mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs// phrag dog yul ni rnam par spangs// rtag tu dga' ba'i yid ldan pa// 'dod chags chen po gcig pu'i yid// slob pa de ni shes pas na// bla ma de lta bu la bya// zhes gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'o// gnyis pa ni ye shes thig le las// slob ma khrims ldan dul zhing dad pa can// rlabs chen zab mo'i theg pa bsten par byed// rnam rtog 'dam gyis rtag tu ma gos shing*// mkhas shing blo rno thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa ni/ de lta bu'i dpon slob phan tshun skyon yon legs par brtag dgos te/

phyag rgya chen po thig le las// ji ltar bsregs la sogs pas gser// ji ltar mkhas pas rin po che// ji ltar bde ldan bu mo ni// de ltar slob ma brtag par bya// de bas thams cad rab 'bad de// phan tshun so sor brtag par bya// de ltar min na skyon du 'gyur// nam yang dngos grub 'thob mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar skyon yon legs par brtags nas/ spang bya'i slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid ldan pa rnams dor nas/ bsten bya'i mtshan nyid can rnams slob dpon tu sbrel lo// de lta ma yin na skyon du 'gyur te/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ bla ma dang ni slob ma dag /mtshungs par dam tshig nyams 'gyur bas// dpa' bos dang po slob dpon dang*// slob ma'i 'brel ba brtag par bya// zhes gsungs pas so// bzhi pa la gsum/ slob ma dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ tshogs pas bya ba'o// dang po ni/ de ltar brtags pa'i snod dang ldan pa'i slob ma des/ bsten rung gi slob dpon de la/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba gdab ste/ sdom 'byung las/ thal mo sbyar ba byas nas ni// gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba gdab// ces so/ de ltar ma byas na skyon du 'gyur te/ rdo rje gur las/ gang gis slob dpon gsol ma btab// 'dir ni rigs su skye ba med// ces so// des kyang*/ bla mas ston par mi spro na/ slar yang mchod pas mnyes par byas la/ lan gsum du gsol ba gdab ste/ bla ma lnga bcu par/ pus btsugs thal mo sbyar ba yis// nyan sogs 'dod la gsol gsum gdab// ces gsungs pas so// gnyis pa ni/ legs so sbyin pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rgyud don rtogs dka' zhing*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung dka' la/ nyams na nyes pa che bas gnyis ka phung bar 'gyur ba'i tshul bshad de/ rdo rje phreng bar/ ji ltar seng ge'i 'o ma ni// sa yi snod du bzhag mi bya// de bzhin rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud// snod min dag la sbyin mi bya// slob ma skad cig de la 'chi// 'di dang pha rol du ni phung*// snod min man ngag rab bshad na// slob dpon dngos grub nyams par 'gyur// zhes pa'i don bshad/

de yang gsol ba 'debs na/ thog mar dbang bskur nas snod du rung bar byed dgos te/ phyag rgya chen po thig las/ dang por re zhig slob ma la// dbang rnams lan gcig bskur ba yis// de tshe gsang chen bshad pa yi// nges par snod du gyur pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas dug la sngags kyis btab pa bzhin du/ slob ma'i rgyud dbang bskur bas dag par byas nas rgyud bshad de/ phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ ji ltar dug la rang sngags kyis// dag par byas nas bdud rtsir 'gyur// de bzhin slob ma dbang sogs kyis// lus ni dri ma med par 'gyur// zhes so// de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas bshad thabs kyi man ngag las 'byung ba ltar bshad do// gsum pa ni/ slob mas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis srung 'khor bsgom/ gnyis kas rgyud kyi srung ma rnams la gtor ma 'bul/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams sngon du 'gro bas lhag pa'i lha'i bskyed rim gyi ngang la 'chad nyan bya'o// lnga pa ni/ rgyud kyi don bshad pa dang*/ nyan pas rgyud don ji lta ba bzhin rtogs te/ de dag gi don bsgoms pas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur te/ ye shes snying por/ man ngag thob pa las brtson 'grus chen po dang ldan pa yin na/ tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas gsungs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// de ltar bdag gis rgyud kyi byung tshul dang*// brgyud pa'i rnam thar 'chad nyan bya tshul sogs// sngon chad sa 'og gter bzhin gyur pa rnams// yang dag lung gis brgyan nas rnam par sbyar// rgyud dang de 'grel gong ma'i gsung rab las// rnam mang lung gi chu rgyun drangs pa yi// legs bshad ngo mtshar rgya mtsho che 'di la// don gnyer ngang pa'i tshogs kun ci dgar rol// 'di bris dge ba bsil zer byed pa des// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i ngan rtog pad mo'i tshal// rab tu zum nas rnam dag gsung rab kyi// 'od dkar mkhas pa'i khrod du 'char bar shog

/ces pa 'di ni dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi ngo bo sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la sogs pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la dbang 'byor pas/ gdul bya rnams kyi re ba skong bar mdzad pa'i bdag nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pas sdom pa gsum phyin ci ma log pa thob cing*/ chos dang zang zing gi bka' drin gyis nye bar bskyangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang po la chos 'di don du gnyer zhing blo gros phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ dge bshes sangs rgyas blo gros kyis yang yang bskul zhing*/ byang bu'i rkyen sbyar ba la brten nas/ sa skyong gi lo nag pa zla ba'i tshes lnga la chos grwa chen po dpal sa skyar sbyar ba'o// // ༄// rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi 'gyur// ༈ /a tha badz+rī ma hā rā dza he badz+ra sarba daḥpra bhuḥsarba kā ra swa bhā wā t+ma maṇ+ḍa laṃ saṃ pra kā ṣa ye/ su khā pat+yaṃ sa mā sī na ཿsarba kā ra swa rū pa taḥtsit+ta badz+ra s+ya bī dze na ni ṣ+pan+no maṇ+ḍa le shwa raḥ de nas rgyal chen rdo rje 'dzin// kun stsol khyab bdag kye rdo rje// rnam pa kun gyi rang bzhin bdag /dkyil 'khor yang dag rab gsal ba// mi mnyam pa yi bde ba can// rnam pa kun gyi rang bzhin las// thugs kyi rdo rje'i sa bon gyis// phun sum tshogs pa'i dkyil 'khor dbang*// phyag ni bcu drug zhal brgyad pa// zhes sogs dang 'brel pa 'di/ rje btsun 'brog mi/ 'gos lots+tsha ba/ gyi jo lots+tsha ba/ shong lots+tsha ba rnams kyis bsgyur ba'i rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis la med pa/ rgya dpe gsum la snang la/ bi but+pa ta'i lots+tsha ba dge slong kun dga' bzang pos dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por bsgyur ba'o// // ༄// kye rdo rje'i 'grel pa'i dkar chag/

༈ /dpal ldan brtag pa gnyis pa yi// rgyud kyi tshig don 'grel byed pa// rdo rje snying po nā ro pa// nag po spyod pa bha wa pa// ḍa ka da sha pad+ma pa// mi thub zla ba shān+ti pa// dam tshig rdo rje pad myug dang*// ka ma dhe nu chos grags te// 'phags yul 'grel pa bcu gnyis mthong*// 'on kyang chos grags 'grel pa ni// bod mar mkhas pa 'ga' zhig bzhed// gangs ri'i rdo rjes mdzad pa yi// bka' 'grel yod de sngon ma 'gyur// bod na rwa rngog dpyal se sogs// bshad pa'i bka' srol mang na yang*// mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan sa skya pa'i// lugs pa bla ma mnga' ris pa// gsal ba'i snying po'i tshig 'grel dang*// sgyi chu ba yi bka' 'grel yod// rje btsun sa chen yab sras kyi// dka' 'grel nyi 'od dag ldan gsum// spyi rnam rgyud kyi mngon rtogs sogs// khyad par 'phags pa'i gzhung bdun yod// shākya grags dang khong ston te// gong ma'i rjes 'brang ṭī ka gnyis// rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug grags// chos kyi seng ge gzhon nu 'bum// kun dga' 'od zer bkra shis dpal// rdo rje tshul khrims 'bre ston te// 'phags pa'i rjes 'brang ṭī ka brgyad// chos rje bla ma gnas drug pa// 'jigs med grags dang bsod nams grags// rgyal po dpal dang rgyal ston dang*// dkon gzhon kun dga' bkra shis te// sna tshogs bsdus pa'i ṭī ka brgyad// tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gzungs kyi dpal// grags rgyal blo gros seng ge ste// mchan dang dag chung bsres pa bzhi// ye dang gnyan ston gung pa dang*// ston gzhon rdo rje shes rab ste// 'phags pa'i rjes 'brang zin bris lnga// gzhan yang 'dis byas med pa yi// ṭī ka zin bris bka' 'grel sogs// snga rabs mkhas pas sbyar ba yi// yig cha rab tu mang po mthong*// bshad rgyud rdo rje gur 'di la// lha yi rigs kyi brtul zhugs kyi// bka' 'grel de nyid rgyas pa yod// in+d+ra bhū ti nag po pa'i// bka' 'grel yod mod 'gyur khyad yin//

// ༄// ḍom+bhi he ru ka'i lugs kyi dpal kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bskyed rim gsal byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam thar zhal ldan de nyid spyan gyis mdzes// stong nyid phyag ldan snying rje'i thod pas spras// phyag rgya drug ldan mgo bo'i do shal can// bsdu dngos bzhi ldan bdun bzhi 'joms la 'dud// rgyud dang sbyang dka' zla ba'i 'grel pa dang*// rgya bod mkhas pa rnams kyi rjes 'brangs nas// dpal ldan kye yi rdo rje sgrub pa'i thabs// bskyed rim gsal byed bdag gis 'dir bshad bya// 'dir grub pa'i dbang phyug ḍom+bhi he ru ka'i lugs kyi rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bya ba la/ lha'i rnal 'byor gyi sngon 'gro// dngos gzhi rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor/ rjes thun mtshams kyi bya ba dang gsum gyi/ dang po la/ tshogs gnyis bsag pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ dbang thob la ma nyams pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dur khrod la sogs pa dben pa'i gnas su/ gla rtsi la sogs pa'i dris byug cing me tog bkram nas/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje chen po nye bar bskyed nas/ de dag phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang la dgod par 'dod pa'i sems kyis bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas/ rang skad cig gis dpal kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i snying gar paṃ las pad+ma dmar po dang*/ ḍom+bhi pas/ a las zla bar bshad pa ltar ram/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ sngon po gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba de las dbugs phyir rgyu ba'i dus su/ sna bug g.yas nas 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i tshul can spros pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ rdo rje bsdus pa'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs la/

ḍom+bhi pa'i/ gang phyir thabs chen bdag nyid ni// dngos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin can// dpal ldan kun rtog thams cad spangs// mgon po he ru ka la 'dud// glang po rta sogs nad brgyad phyag brgyad 'dzin cing lhag ma g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad kyis dbang phyug brgyad kyi phun tshogs nor 'dzin dang por 'dzin pa dbang phyug ni// sprin men nam mkha'i mthil du brgyad pa'i zla phyed kyi zil gnon thod pa'i phreng ba can// phyag gi yal ga'i spyi bo me tog rgyan mdzad he ru ka dpal khyod kyis skyong*// zhes pas phyag byas nas/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i me tog la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags rgyas me tog nas zhal zas kyi bar gyis mchod par ḍom+bi pa'i gzhung du bshad la/ ku mu ti dang*/ sgrub thabs gnyis dang bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs las ni mi 'byung ngo*// yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las gau rī la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad rang rang gi mchod rdzas 'dzin pa spros te/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'khod nas/ phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang de kho na nyid kyis mchod par bsams la/ rin chen 'bar bar / dkar mo ri dwags mtshan pa 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod// ces pas mchod nas rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis/ rin chen 'bar bar/ bdag gis thog ma med dus nas// log rtog dbang gis sdig bgyis gang*// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag khyed rnams kyi// spyan sngar bshags bgyid slan chad bsdam// rgyal dang de yi sras rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i bsod nams ma lus pa// de la yang dag yi rangs zhing*// byang chub dam par bsngo bar bgyi// gang dang gang gis 'dul 'gyur ba// de yang de yi skur ston pa// sna tshogs gzugs nor ji lta bu'i// rdzogs sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi// kun rtog ma lus dag gyur pa// rang rig yang dag ye shes bskyed// lhan cig skyes dga'i ngo bo nyid// dam pa'i chos la'ang skyabs su mchi// go rim ji bzhin dbang bskur thob// ma log lam la nges gnas dang*// sras mchog 'khor 'dus tshogs mchog la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// yang dag ye shes me bo ches// gti mug mun pa bsal ba dang*// sgrib pa ma lus sbyang ba'i phyir// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// rgyal sras dpa' bo rnams kyi lam// spyod pa dpag gang yin dang*// ma bcos ji bzhin gnas lam la// da ni yang dag gnas par bgyi// zhes lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags byas te/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta āt+ma naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ zhes pas bdag phul bas/ tshogs rten gyi gtso bos gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ de nas nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par 'dod pa'i byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i 'dod pa'i snying rje dang*/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa'i dga' ba dang*/ dgra gnyen chags sdang thams cad dang bral bar 'dod pa'i btang snyoms te/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs so// phyi nang gi chos thams cad snang yang bden pas stong par sgyu ma lta bur bsams nas/ ḍom+bi bas rang bzhin med phyir stong pa nyid// rgyu med phyir na mtshan ma med// rang gi kun rtog rnam phye bas// 'gro ba smon pa med pa yin// oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs te/ sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis bsags pa'o// gnyis pa srung 'khor la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor gnyis kyi dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo nyi shu pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ de las 'od zer phyogs su 'phros pas/ rdo rje nag po gdengs pa 'greng bur gyur pa/ bar mtshams med pa'i rwa ba steng du 'phros pas rdo rje'i gur dang bla re// 'og tu 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyir 'phros pas ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga pa 'bar bzhin pas bskor bar bsams la/ oṃ rgyud 'grel rgya gzhung rnams su badz+ra mi snang*/ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas brtan par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ ḍom+bi pa'i gzhung dang*/ ku mu ti/ yan lag drug pa rnams su gsal bar ma bshad kyang*/ rin chen 'bar bar/ rwa ba bla re gur nang du// khro bo bcus kyang bsrung bar bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar byed par spro na/

de lta bu'i thun mong gi srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ ser po las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa rtse mo rno ba/ khog pa stong pa/ g.yas phyogs su 'gro ba mi mngon par mgyogs par 'khor ba/ de'i dbus dang phyogs bcur pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bcu gcig de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ re re/ de'ang lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/ steng gi ser po/ gzhan rnams sngon po/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad sku mdog sngon po/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ shar du gshin rje gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po rdo rje/ dbang ldan du 'dod pa'i rgyal po nag po lcags kyu/ mer dbyung sngon can nag po dbyug pa/ bden bral du stobs po che nag po rtse gsum/ rlung du mi g.yo ba nag po ral gri/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo/ 'og tu gnod mdzes nag po g.yas gtun shing 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dbus dang phyogs bzhi'i khro bo rnams zhal mche ba gtsigs shing*/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ sku sbom zhing thung la gsus khyim che ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra dang*/ smin ma dang*/ sma ra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ mtshams kyi khro bo rnams ni rol pa'i sku can/ cung zad sgeg cing yid tsam khros pa/ sku skem zhing rid pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ thams cad kyi sku la rang 'dra'i khro bo dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bgegs kyi tshogs tshar gcod pa/

g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsams te dam tshig pa bskyed pa'o// 'dir de nyid bcu par/ gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba g.yas brkyang du bshad pa'i rigs pas/ khro bo thams cad g.yas brkyang du bstan pa ni phyir bzlog gi tshe yin la/ 'dir bsrung ba'i skabs su ni/ rin chen 'bar ba las/ zhabs g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa'o zhes dang*/ gur gyi sgrub thabs las kyang de bzhin du bshad do// rgyas par byed na rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ khro bo bcu srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa la ye shes kyi khro bo bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod nas/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gau rī la sogs pa'i phyag rgyas dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya ba ste ye shes pa dgug pa'o// lha thams cad kyi mig la sogs pa'i gnas drug tu/ gti mug rdo rje sogs drug dang*/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum 'og nas 'byung ba ltar 'god de/ skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa'o// slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro bas mchod cing*/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad dang sngags kyis dbang bskur/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pas/ hūm̐ mdzad dang shes rab mthar byed 'dod rgyal gnod mdzes rnams la mi bskyod pa/ gshin rje gshed dbyug sngon can gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ pad+ma mthar byed dang stobs po che la 'od dpag med/ bgegs mthar byed dang mi g.yo ba la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par bsams te/ dbang bskur zhing rig kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab bo// de nas khro bo'i dbang po rnams kyi gzi brjid kyis bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad bskrad te/

dpag tshad brgya'i chad tshun chad bsrung bar bsams te/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sogs brjod pa ni srung ba'i 'khor lo'o// 'di dag ni ḍom+bhi pa'i de nyid bcu'i dgongs pa ltar bris pa yin/ sbyang dka' zla ba'i gur gyi sgrub thabs las/ srung 'khor gyi phyogs bcur khro bo bcu sngar bzhin bsams nas/ dbus kyi hūm̐ mdzad mi bsgom par srung 'khor tshar ba dang*/ dbus su 'byung ba bzhi las gzhal yas khang bskyed par bshad do// srung 'khor bsdus pa la ni ye shes pa rnams bskyed nas dbu rgyan rang chas su bsgoms la/ bsrung bar bsams pas chog par mngon la/ bzlog pa'i man ngag ni/ bdag gi bla mas mdzad pa'i gur gyi sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// gnyis pa rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor dngos la rten bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ brten pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis kyi dang po la/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i/ dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i/ bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi/ mchod pa don yod grub pa'i/ bstod pa rin 'byung dang drug gi dang po ni/ srung 'khor gyi rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad zhu ba las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ de'i nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas bskor ba/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'i steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ de rnams la oṃ āḥhūṃ ho dmar po gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i shes pa zhugs nas thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/

phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du/ rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ steng nas mda' yab dang pu shus mdzes par byas pa/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo/ steng du gdugs/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang gos la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ rtsig pa'i rtsa ba'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la pi wang ma la sogs pa mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug rang rang gi phyag mtshan thogs nas dkyil 'khor la mchod pa dbul ba/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mi mangs ris su phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa'i 'od zer kun tu 'khrugs pa/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad ni ḍom+bi pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gzhung rnams su ma bshad pas med kyang chog la/ byed par 'dod na/ slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa'i man ngag lugs kyi mngon rtogs ltar bya'o// gzhal yas khang gi nang phyogs mdog can gyi dbus su/ ḍom+bi pas pad+ma dmar por bshad pa ltar ram/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ dbus su bdud bzhi'i gdan dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang sngon po/ byang du drag po nag po/ byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po nag po/ nub byang du thag zangs ris dud kha rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen la phyogs par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nāṃ la badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal gzung ngo*// yan lag gnyis pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo ā li phrag gnyis yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba me long lta bu'i ye shes/

de'i steng du dpe byad brgyad bcu'i ngo bo kā li phrag gnyis yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ dang aṃ las rdo rje dang gri gug hūm̐ dang aṃ gis mtshan par ku mu ti dang sgrub thabs gnyis su bshad la/ ḍom+bi pas/ dbus su āḥhūm̐ rnam par bsam// de gnyis las thod gri gug dag /ces hūm̐ las thod pa dang aṃ las gri gug tu bshad de so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes/ de la lha'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar zhing chu shel ltar dwangs pa/ nor bu ltar 'od 'phro ba/ zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa/ spyan ni nyi shu pa bzhis phye ba/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/ lhag ma thams cad nag po/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing*/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal kha/ drug pa ni mi dmar po/ bdun pa na seng ge sngon po/ brgyad pa ni byi la nag po/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu lha dkar po/ gsum pa na rlung lha ljang gu/ bzhi pa na me lha dmar po/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor sbyin ser po 'dzin pa ku mu ti dang sgrub thabs gnyis su bshad la/ ḍom+bi pas/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rnga mo/ lnga pa na ba/ bdun pa na byi la/ brgyad pa na seng ge g.yon gyi gsum pa na me/ bzhi pa na rlung*/ lnga par zla ba/ drug par nyi ma bshad do// dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/

rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ 'khor lo la sogs pa rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs sam/ rin chen 'bar ba ltar na/ zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa/ rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ sgeg pa la sogs pa gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pa thod pa 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ ḍom+bi pas dku g.yon du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin par bshad cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas pas yab la 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsams te/ rgyu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa'o// de nas yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang*/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma as mtshan par bsams la/ oṃ pad+ma su kha dha ra ma hā rā ga su khaṃ da da tsa tu rā nan+da bha ga bi shwa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā dwe ṣa tsa tu rā nan+da da ya ka kha ga mu kha e ka ra so nā tha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ thabs shes rab snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de yum gyi bha gar babs nas/ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ/ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ/ zhes pa'i sa bon brgyad du gyur/ de las lha mo brgyad du gyur nas phyir spros pas/

gzugs kyi rang bzhin/ shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas pas gri gug g.yon pas nya 'dzin pa/ sgra'i rang bzhin/ lhor tsau rī dmar mo g.yas pas cang te'u/ g.yon pas phag rgod 'dzin pa/ dri'i rang bzhin/ nub tu ro langs ma ser mo g.yas pas rus sbal/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ ro'i rang bzhin/ byang du ghasma rī ljang khu g.yas pas sprul/ g.yon pas thod pa 'dzin pa/ sa rnam par dag pa/ byang shar du puk+ka sī sngon mo g.yas pas seng ge g.yon dgra s+t+wa/ chu rnam par dag pa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas pas dge slong*/ g.yon gsil byed/ me rnam par dag pa/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thod pa/ 'di'i sa bon ḍom+bi pas tsa du bshad/ rlung rnam par dag pa/ nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas pas rdo rje/ g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can du ḍom+bi pas bshad/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas spras pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsams te/ 'khor gyi lha mo dbyung ba'o// de nas yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras nam mkha' nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum hoḥganyis kyi mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa bcom ldan 'das kyi sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs/ yum gyi mkhar sleb pa'i rkyen gyis yab yum gnyis rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu ste/ bde ba chen po'i ngo bo thig le sngo skyar gyur par bsams la/ de nas mtshams kyi lha mo bzhis gtso bo ma mthong bas sdug bsngal nas bzhengs pa'i phyir glus bskul ba la/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /ces sogs kyis bskul bar/ ku mu ti dang*/ sgrub thabs gnyis su bshad pas de bzhin bya ba'am/

yang na/ puk+ka sīs/ bzhengs shig bcom ldan thugs rje'i thugs mnga' ba// dur khrod 'phyan ma bdag la yongs su skyobs// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin spangs nas su// bde ba chen po'i rol pas sbyor bar mdzod// ri khrod mas/ khyod mi bzhugs na bdag gi 'gum 'gyur bas// dges pa'i rdo rje khyod ni bzhengs par mdzod// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin spangs nas ni// ri khrod ma bdag bya ba bsgrub par mdzod// tsaṇ+ḍa līs/ chags mchog gtso bo 'jig rten mgron gnyer nas// stong pa nyid kyi ngo bor ci phyir bzhugs// khyod mi bzhugs na bdag ni lus 'jig pas// gtum mo khyod ni bdag la rol par mdzod// g.yung mos/ khyod kyi thugs ni bdag gis 'tshal lags kyis// sgyu ma'i mkhan po khyod ni bzhengs par mdzod// thugs rje rnam par chad par mi mdzad cing*// tshad med thugs kyis g.yung mo bdag rol mdzod// ces pas bskul bar ḍom+bi pas bshad de/ zhu ba glus bskul ba'o// de nas sngon gyi smon lam rjes su dran pas/ thig le las aṃ dang hūm̐ las bzhengs par ku mu ti dang sgrub thabs gnyis su bshad la/ ḍom+bi pas/ aṃ dang hūm̐ las gri gug dang thod pa de las bzhengs par bshad/ gang ltar yang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog sngon po/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ lhag ma thams cad rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa ltar yum dang bcas pa bsam mo// de nas lha thams cad kyi thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ la sogs pa rang rang gi sa bon las so so'i phyag mtshan so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa las/ rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba'i thugs kar/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ la sogs pa so so'i sa bon bsgom par ku mu ti dang yan lag drug pa sogs kyi dgongs pa yin la/ rin chen 'bar ba las kyang gsal bar gsungs te/ yab yum 'khor bcas thugs kar ni/

pad nyi sa bon phyag mtshan las// ye shes sems dpa' bskyed par bya// zhes so// de nas thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od zer phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs la/ nyer spyod dang lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// zhes sogs kyis bstod nas/ snying ga'i sa bon las gau rī lcags kyu thogs pa spros te ye shes pa'i thugs kar reg pas/ srung 'khor gyi nang du byon par bsams la/ de nyid bsdus pa nas bshad pa'i lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dza/ zhes brjod/ yang tsau rī zhags pa thogs pa spros/ ye shes pa'i mgrin par reg pas dam tshig pa la thim par bsam zhing*/ zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ yang sa bon las be tā lī lcags sgrog thogs pa spros/ ye shes pa'i zhabs la reg pas dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bsams la/ lcags sgrog gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bai tā lī ban+dha baṃ/ yang ghasma rī dril bu thogs pa spros/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi nang thams cad gang bas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dges par bsams la/ dril bu'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī ba shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes brjod/ de nas lha thams cad kyi mig gnyis su/ maṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna ba gnyis su daṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar paṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lcer raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral par aṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ snying gar naṃ las bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo// spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ thugs kar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma nag mo rnams dgod pa ku mu ti dang sgrubs thabs gnyis las bshad la/

ḍom+bi pas gti mug rdo rje sogs drug dang*/ gzugs la gau rī/ sgra la tsau rī/ dri la be tā lī/ ro la ghasma rī/ reg la sa spyod ma/ chos kyi dbyings la mkha' spyod ma/ gzugs phung rdo rje ma/ tshor phung dkar mo/ 'du shes chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ 'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ rnam shes bdag med ma/ sa'i khams la puk+ka sī/ chu la ri khrod ma/ me la gtum mo/ rlung la g.yung mo rnams dgod par bshad do// thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ ro'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs par bsam mo// yan lag gsum pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang bskur gyi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo drug dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi// khyed kyis bdag la dbang skur cig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur te/ bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa phyag na bsnams nas/ dbang bskur bar bsams la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum dang*/ gau rī dang puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha ba rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ be tā lī dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī la rin 'byung*/ ghasma rī dang ḍom+bī nī la 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan par bsams la/ dbang gi lha thams cad mi dmigs par bsams nas/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do// yan lag bzhi pa ni/ mdun du thod par chang la bdud rtsi ril bu la sogs pas bkang ba bzhag la/ de bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa rnams 'og gtor ma ltar byas la/ lha dgu'i ljags rnams las rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyis mtshan par bsams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do// yan lag lnga pa ni/ sngar ltar lha mo brgyad kyis mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do// yan lag drug pa ni/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dkyil 'khor la bstod par bsams la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// zhes pa'am/ yang na/ 'gro ba dug chen mi bzad pas// khyab par bzhugs nas he ru ka /sna tshogs tshul gyis bdud rtsir bsgyur// sman mchog dpa' bo khyod la 'dud// ces rin chen 'bar ba las bshad pas bstod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod la lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems bzung bas/ du ba la sogs pa'i rtags drug mthong bar slob dpon 'di'i rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i bzhed pa ste bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa tsaṇ+ḍa lī la sogs pa'i man ngag bsgoms te/ de'i tshul yang rin chen 'bar ba'i rdzogs rim le'u las shes par bya'o// gsum pa thun mtshams kyi bya ba la/ nyal ba la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor lnga ni/ slob dpon rin po che'i man ngag lugs kyi sgrub thabs ltar go bar byas la/ thun mtshams su bsgoms pas skyo na/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsdus la/ rang gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la// byams pa'i thugs la yan lag gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni// zhabs ni rnam par bzhi zhes brjod// zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad// phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid// gug skyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid// spyan gsum po ni sku gsum yin// rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid// gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin no// tshor ba gsang ba'i dkar mo nyid// 'du shes phung po chu ma nyid// 'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// 'dir ni rnam shes bdag med ma// don dam la ni phung po med// skye mched drug ni rnam dag phyir// de nyid drug po nyid du 'gyur// zhe sdang rdo rje rdo rje ma// rdo rje ro ma chu ma nyid// phrag dog rdo rje ma dang ni// de bzhin gti mug rdo rje ma// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ru 'gyur// ser sna gsang ba'i dkar mo nyid// yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma// sa ni puk+ka sī zhes bshad// chu khams rngon pa ma zhes bya// me ni gtum mor shes par bya// rlung ni g.yung mor rab tu grags// gzugs la dkar mor rtag tu bshad// sgra la chom rkun mar rab grags// dri yi cha la ro langs ma// ro yi gzugs can ghasma rī// reg la sa spyod ma nyid de// chos kyi dbyings la mkha' spyod ma// dbang phyug thams cad rab bsgrub phyir// sa ni dang po nor sbyin mtha'// glang po la sogs sems can gyis// nad rnams zhi phyir 'dzin pa'o// glo dang dbugs dang de bzhin 'bog

/khong skem mdze dang 'brum bu dang*// mchin pa mcher ba'i rang bzhin yang*// glang po la sogs rab tu grags// zhes pas dag pa dran par byas nas/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bgrang phreng bzung ste/ rang gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi thugs ka'i aṃ las sngags kyi phreng ba zhi sogs kyi las dang mthun pa'i kha dog can spros/ yum gyi zhal nas 'thon/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste/ pad+mar zhugs nas sku'i dbyibs brgyud de/ yang yum gyi zhal nas byung bar bsgom zhing*/ 'khor rnams kyi steng 'og tu 'khor bar bsams la/ oṃ aṣ+ṭā na nā ya/ piṃ ga lor+dha ke sha warta ma ne/ tsa tur biṃ sha ti ni trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇa dzī mu ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la a nai kaṃ dha ri ṇe/ adh+ma tā krū ra tsit+tā ya/ ar+dhen+du daṃṣ+ṭi ṇa/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga rān/ ban+dha ban+dha/ nā ga aṣ+ṭa kān/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ha hā/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai ho hau haṃ ha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rtsa sngags so/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o// oṃ badz+ra karta ri he badz+rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o// oṃ a ā i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rnal 'byor ma'i phreng sngags so// oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ bdag med ma'i 'o// oṃ āḥgaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥghaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥpaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥshaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥḍaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gau rī la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad kyi sngags te/ 'di dag gtso bo la ji tsam bzlas pa'i bcu cha 'khor rnams la bzla ba bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// de ltar bsgom bzlas kyis skyo na/

thun mtshams su tshogs bsag pa'i don du/ maṇ+ḍal khru gang bas mi chung ba la ba'i rnam lnga dang*/ dri bzang dang bdud rtsi lngas g.yas skor du byug shing*/ oṃ me di ni badz+rī bha wa ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa zhes brjod de/ srung ba'i 'khor lo gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis bskyed la/ gtso bo'i gnas su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang*/ 'khor rnams la zlum por byas nas/ dbus su hūm̐ shrī he ru kā ya na ma/ dpal kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa sogs dang*/ shar du gaṃ gau rī na ma/ gau rī nag mo zhes bya ba la sogs pa rang rang gi mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i dri'i thig le dang*/ me tog gi tshom bu byas la lha dgu yongs su rdzogs par bsgoms te/ dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pa'o// de nas gtso 'khor thams cad sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bsgom/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la mchod nas/ gau rī la sogs pa'i sngags rgyas dgug gzhug bcing dbang du byas te/ ye shes pa gzhug pa'o// de nas mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa lha mo drug bsgoms te/ skye mched byin gyis brlab pa'o// yang dbang bskur gyi lha spyan drangs nas mchod cing gsol ba btab ste/ dbang bskur nas sngar ltar rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab ste/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa'o// de ltar mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrub pa la/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dbul ba'i phyir/ maṇ+ḍal gyi g.yas rang gi g.yon phyogs nas zhabs bsil la sogs pa'i chu bzhi dang*/ rang gi g.yas maṇ+ḍal gyi g.yon nas me tog la sogs pa'i nyer spyod lnga dang*/ rang gi g.yon du thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang*/ g.yas su rdo rje dril bu rnams bzhag la/ las thams cad pa'i dri chu'am chang la bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar bas mchod rdzas rnams la gtor zhing*/

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta brjod la bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod par hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod rdzas su bsams la/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i so so'i sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra zhes kun la sbyar zhing*/ rdo rje khu tshur las gung mo gnyis rtse sprad pa zhabs bsil gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ/ zhes brjod la/ de bzhin du/ nai wi t+ye hūm̐ khaṃ gis zhal bsil dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ gis 'thor 'thung dang*/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās mchod yon phul te/ chu bzhi ka'ang phyag rgya ni 'dra'o// de nas me tog gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog dang*/ bdug pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos dang*/ mar me'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ dri mchog gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri mchog zhal zas kyis phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi t+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+da āḥhūm̐ gis dang*/ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta'i sngags kyis rol mo 'bul te/ phyi'i mchod pa'o// de nas sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod kyi dbus nas mtheb srin gyis blangs te gtor zhing*/ thog mar rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la 'bul/ de nas 'di'i brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ bde mchog la sogs pa gzhan gyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang*/ de nas yi dam gyi lha rnams la rang rang gi sngags kyi rjes su oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la dbul/ de nas chos skyong phyogs skyong dang*/ gzhi bdag rnams la'ang 'phul nas/ rang nyid kyis myangs te nang gi mchod pa'o// de nas mchod pa nyi shu pa dang*/ lha mo brgyad la sogs pas mchod pa ni/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pa'o// de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/

dhe ha dha tu'i glu'i mchod pa'am/ yang na/ slob dpon ḍom+bi pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa bya ste/ bstod pa'i mchod pa'o// de nas gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na/ mdun bskyed kyi g.yas su 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma phud las chung bar bya zhing*/ g.yon du 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma lhag ma las che bar byas la/ gnyis ka'ang bdud rtsi lngas sbag cing*/ chu dang chang gis sbyangs nas/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi dur khrod brgyad du/ hūm̐ brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po// nub byang du rlung lha/ byang shar du dbang ldan/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng gi cha la/ byang shar du chos 'byung gi steng du pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma la/ oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su sku rdo rje/ shar du dbang phyug chen po/ lhor lha'i dbang po/ nub tu tshangs pa/ byang du khyab 'jug shar lhor 'dod ba'i dbang phyug lho nub tu tshogs kyis bdag po/ nub byang du bhṛng gi ri ti/ byang shar du gzhon nu karti ka thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po/ maṇ+ḍal gyi 'og gi cha la/ lho nub tu chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la/ āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong*/ nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du nor rgyas/ shar lhor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du pad+ma/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po/ kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i rig ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i sems can thams cad lha chen brgyad la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum la thim par bsam/

yang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs spyan drangs la/ gau rī la sogs pa'i sngags rgyas dgug gzhug bcing dbang du byas nas/ gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha spyan drangs la mchod cing gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam snang*/ phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung dang*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a las thod pa dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du go las ba lang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha// dbus su na las mi'i sha/ sha lnga po re re'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las dri chen/ aṃ las rak+ta/ dz+rīṃ las byang sems/ khaṃ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ hūm̐ las dri chu ste bdud rtsi lnga lnga dang*/ de rnams kyi steng du bh+rūm̐ la sogs pa'i sa bon lnga bsams la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du ā li bcu drug g.yon skor dang*/ kā li so bzhi g.yas skor du bsams te/ de dag gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo thur du blta ba/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos shing me sbar nas/ thod pa'i nang gi sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga po bzhus shing bskol bas/ rlangs pa gyen du song bas oṃ dang hūm̐ la phog pas de gnyis nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag pa/ yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi he ru ka phyag gnyis par spyan drangs rdo rje'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje ljid dang ldan par gyur/

rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thams cad thod pa'i nang du lhung bas rdzas thams cad zhu nas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par bsams nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ yang yang brjod do// gtor ma byin brlab 'di ḍom+bi pa'i de nyid bcu pa dang*/ mi thub zla ba'i gtor chog la sogs pa slob dpon rjes 'brang dang bcas pa dang*/ rgya gzhung mang po las mgron bskyed pa'i rjes la 'byung ngo*// de nas rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye te/ ngag tu/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ in+da/ dza ma/ dza la/ dzak+kha/ bhū ta/ bah+ni/ bā u/ rak+kha/ tsan+da/ sudz+dza/ mā da/ pap+pa/ ta la pā ta le/ aṭ+ṭa sap+pa swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ bhuñja/ dzi gha/ phul+la/ dhup+pa/ māṃ sa/ piṃ gha/ am+bha/ sap+pa/ kadz+dza/ swa da khan+ti/ khu ṇi/ phe ḍa gā da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twā ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun brjod pas phul la/ phyi dang nang gi mchod nas/ rdo rje dril bu gsil zhing dkar mo ri dwags dang*/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs dang*// mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che// rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri med mkha'// rang bzhin dag cing gos pa med// rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje mi 'chi rgyal po che// mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// dag pa'i ngo bo nyid las byung*// rdo rje sems dpar phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod nas/

lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi bar mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas phrin las gzhol/ skabs 'di lhag pa'i lha dang*/ sgos kyi chos skyong rnams la'ang gtor ma phul nas/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang ma 'brel na rdo rje'i glu blang*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ 'brel na lhag gtor gyi rjes la bya'i skabs 'dir mi dgos/ de nas mdun bskyed gyi maṇ+ḍal la mchod bstod bsdus pa gcig byas la/ yi ge brgya pa brjod pas bzod par gsol zhing*/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod de/ mtheb srin brdab pa'i se gol gyis maṇ+ḍal gyi ye shes pa dang*/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar bsdu la/

gtor ma gtsang sar dor/ me tog gi tshom bu rnams bsdus/ mchod rdzas dman pa rnams chu bor dor la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de ltar rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la goms par byas nas drod thob ste/ spyod pa gsum gyis mtshams sbyar nas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// dpal ldan kye yi rdo rje sgrub pa'i thabs// thabs mchog sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob byed tshul// tshul bzhin ston pa dpal ldan ḍom+bi'i gzhung*// gzhung gi rjes 'brang bskyed rim gsal byed 'di// rnam dpyod blo yi lus stobs rab rdzogs pas// rmad byung thabs la mkhas pa'i grur zhugs nas// rnam dag dad brtson rlung gis rab bskyod pas// mkhas mang nor bu'i gling 'dir legs phyin pa// sbyin pa'i ming can blo gsal mnga' ris pas// yang yang bskul ngor rgyud gsum smra bas sbyar// dge ba gang des ma gyur 'gro ba rnams// sku bzhi'i go 'phang mchog la rol par shog /ces pa 'di yang dmigs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje can/ chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa rtog med zhabs kyi tsha zer las skyes pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos ḍom+bi he ru kas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ de'i rjes su 'brang ba dpal spyang dka' zla ba'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel ku mu ti'i bskyed rim gyi skabs rnams dang*/ sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa dang*/ rin chen 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs le'u dang*/ rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa bla ma rje btsun chen po'i tho yig la gzhi byas shing*/ ḍom+bi'i chos skor bod du 'gyur ro 'tshal bltas nas/ thams cad 'dul gyi lo snron gyi zla ba'i tshes bcu la/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni skul ba po nyid kyis bgyis so// i daṃ shā sa nash+tsa sarba satwa hi to bha wan+tu// // ༄// 'phrin yig dbang po'i rdo rje bzhugs so//
