༈ /kye rdo rje ḍom+bi he ru ka'i lugs la phyag len du mdzad pa rnams la/ 'phrin du zhu ba dbang po'i rdo rje zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag mkhyen pa'i bya lam rab yangs par// rnam dkar brtse ba'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas nas// rnam mang mi shes mun pa rab bsal ba'i// rnam dpyod gsal ldan rnams la rab tu 'dud// de la khyed kyi sgrub thabs su/ thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor la/ lha rnams bskyed nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs te ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa 'di pa'i lugs pa nor te/ ḍom+bi pa'i lugs la ye shes pa bcug nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa gong 'og thad tu bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// dbyug sngon can dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa'ang nor/ de ltar slob dpon mi thub zla bas gur rigs bsdus kyi sgrub thabs las bshad pa ni rdo rje sems dpa' dang mi bskyod pa gnyis ngo bo gcig pa la dgongs kyi so sor bya mi dgos pas/ bla ma gong mas bshad pa ltar thams cad la/ mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab la/ ḍom+bi pa'i dgongs pa ni gzhan zhig yod do// lha rnams zhal phyir gzigs pa dang*/ sngags bzlas pa rnams kyang nor te/ 'dir srung ba'i dbang du mdzad nas hūm̐ mdzad dbus su bzhag 'khor los bsgyur ba steng du yod la de'i sngags zlos pa sogs ma bshad do// bla ma gong mas rang srung ba tsam bsgom par 'dod na mngon par rtogs pa dang ma 'brel bar gud du bsgom pa ni med de/ de yang mngon par rtogs pa thams cad gong ma dang 'dra ba las/ 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor ba dang*/ dbus su hūm̐ mdzad bsgom zhing*/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba bzhag pa dang*/ lha rnams zhal nang du gzigs pa dang*/ sngags bzla mi dgos so zhes pa dang*/ gur rgyan las/ srung ba byed na gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba steng du bzhag cing*/

hūm̐ mdzad dbus su bcug la 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor ba 'ba' zhig la brten nas sngags mi bzla na srung ba 'grub pa yin no// zhes bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// gal te de dag ni man ngag lugs kyi dbang du byas la/ 'dir ḍom+bi pa'i lugs so zhe na ma yin te/ ḍom+bi pa'i de nyid bcu par/ srung ba dang bzlog pa gnyis gsungs pa'i skabs su bla ma gong mas gsungs pa bzhin bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ slob dpon mi thub zla bas/ rigs bsdus kyi sgrub thabs su bsrung ba'i dbang du byas nas/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba steng du bzhag cing sngags bzla ba ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro// yang sngags bzla ba dang*/ dmod bcol dang*/ 'khor lo g.yon skor dang*/ khro bo zhal phyir gzigs sogs byed par 'dod na/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba dbus dang hūm̐ mdzad steng du dgod dgos so// mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa'i skabs su/ a nu rā ga ṇa sogs kyi sngags mi brjod par/ man ngag lugs ltar rgyu rdor 'dzin zhu ba'i tshe brjod pa nor te/ mi thub zla ba'i yan lag drug pa dang*/ ku mu ti dang*/ rin chen 'bar ba rnams su mkha' gsang byin brlab kyi skabs su bya bar bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// lha dang gzhal yas khang la yid gtad pa bskyed rim mi rtog pa dang yid bzhag pas du ba sogs rtags drug mthong ba rdzogs rim du byed pa 'di pa'i lugs la nor te/ yan lag drug par/ rjes chags rdo rje sems dpa' 'o// dngos grub 'di ni nye ba yi// yan lag drug gis bskyed pa ni// dang po sprin dang 'dra bar mthong*// zhes sogs dang*/ rigs bsdus sgrub thabs las/ yan lag drug bsgom rnal 'byor pa// rang byin brlab pa rab tu bsgrub// grub pa'i sngon du mtshan ma rnams// rim pa bzhin du brjod par bya// dang po sprin dang 'dra bar snang*// zhes sogs dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// dkyil chog las sa bslang ba dang*/ oṃ ha na ha na sogs sbyang ba'i bar du/

bgegs gzhom zhing srung ba'i cho ga thams cad chad de/ bzang po yongs bzung las/ sa bslang ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o// dge dang mi dge'i mtshan ma dang*// rjes mthun phyi yi nyi ma la// zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba'am// yang na bgegs rnams gzhom par bya// sa 'dzin lta bur brtan pa'i blos// srung ba'i 'khor los sa legs bsrung*// zhes dang*/ rje btsun rtse mos/ de la sa bsrung ba ni 'di yin te/ tshad dang mthun par brkos la 'chad par 'gyur ba'i sngags kyis/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi la sogs pa byas la/ der paṃ dang a las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ bh+rūm̐ ser po las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa bsgoms te/ der hūm̐ bcu gcig bsrung ba de kho na nyid ci lta ba bzhin bskyed la/ zhes sogs kyi bshad pa'i phyir ro// gal te rje btsun rtse mos bgegs gzhom zhing bsrung ba ni/ drang srong gnas dang ba glang lhas zhes sogs kyi gnas su bya mi dgos par bshad la 'di de'i dbang du byas pa'o snyam na/ de ltar na sa sbyang ba'ang mi dgos shing ma bshad pa la/ khyod kyi ha na kro dha sogs kyis ci zhig bya'o// sa sbyang ba dang*/ a pa sa ran+tu sogs kyi bar du/ rje btsun rtse mos klu'i gtso byas pa'i 'byung po thams cad la gtor ma byin la zhi bas bskrad ces gsungs pa'ang chad/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i dbus su rdo rje slob dpon 'dug ces pa nas/ dkyil 'khor nam mkhar btegs la zhes pa'i bar/ 'og sta gon gyi sngon 'gro yin par bzang po yongs bzung dang*/ rin chen 'bar ba dang*/ rje btsun rtse mo rnams kyis bshad pas 'dir byed pa nor la/ 'dir ni bgegs bskrad cing bsrung ba tshar ba dang*/ bzang po yongs bzung las/ rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor bya ste/ mi mthun phyogs bskrad nges pa yi// sa yi dbus su 'dug nas ni// sangs rgyas rnams la gsol ba gdab// ces sogs nas/ slob dpon rdo rje 'chang bas bya// zhes pa'i bar dang*/

de'i don rje btsun rtse mos/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor byas nas kyang*// zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste/ de la slob dpon kha cig ni dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa dang*/ slob mas gsol ba gdab pa yang skabs 'dir 'dod mod kyi/ slob dpon 'di dang*/ slob dpon shes rab bskyangs la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brang ba dang bcas pas/ sa yi bya ba ni rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor gyis byas la der sa yongs su dag par dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba dang 'brel bas sta gon gyi cho ga nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom par bzhed do// de bas na zhes sogs kyi rang dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnal 'byor byas la/ lag pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdo rje dril bu bzung ste ji srid sogs kyis gsol ba gdab cing*/ langs la mig rkang byin gyis brlabs nas dbang ldan du bgegs la bka' bsgo zhing*/ g.yas brkyang la sogs pa'i gar gyi bkod pa thams cad bya bar bshad do// khang pa byin brlab kyi skabs su rje btsun rtse mos/ rdo rje sems dpa' yum dang bcas par gsungs pa la khyed kyis yum chad/ rdo rje dril bu gtso bo yab yum du bskyed pa nor te/ rje btsun rtse mos rdo rje dril bu yang de kho na nyid ltar bsgoms la zhes dang*/ bzang po yongs bzung las kyang*/ rdo rje dril bu la lha dgod tshul rgyas par gsungs pas de dag bya dgos kyi/ gzhan gyis mi rung ngo*// sa lha sta gon tshar ma khad gzhan dang bstun nas lha sta gon byed pa nor te/ bzang po yongs bzung las/ sa lha sta gon tshar nas/ lus khrus bya zhing dri yis byug /ji snyed 'bar ba'i rgyan gyis brgyan// ser po'i gos ni bgos nas ni// phyi dro'i dus su 'jug par bya// dri dang me tog gcal bkram pa'i// dkyil 'khor dbus su 'dug bya ste// zhes pa nas/ rwa ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o// zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa'i don/ rje btsun rtse mos rang dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i dbus su 'dug

phyogs bzhir slob ma bzhi bzhag nas sgrub thabs rgyas par bsgom/ deng dus bdag tshe sogs kyi spro ba bskyed/ slob ma rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ langs te nga rgyal gzung*/ dkyil 'khor bteg rwa gur sogs kyis bsrung*/ phur pa gdab pa sogs sta gon gyi sngon 'gror gsungs pas de thams cad chad pas ches nor ro// bum pa sta gon gyi las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sngar bzhin gsal btab ces dang*/ gong du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa g.yas rdo rje gdengs pa 'dzin pa zhes nor te/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i g.yas kyi phyag mtshan rdo rje gdengs pa yin na/ las bum gyi mtshan ma la'ang de gnyis ka bri mod/ sna tshogs rdo rje bri zhes pas ci zhes bya/ des na las bum gyi bskyed chog gong 'og gnyis kar bdud rtsi 'khyil pa man ngag lugs kyi dbang chu ltar bskyed/ srung 'khor gyi bgegs mthar byed mi bskyed/ mchod bstod byas nas lha rnams zhu ba'i chur bsgoms pa man ngag lugs kyi dbang chu sogs las bshad mod/ 'di pa'i lugs la nor te/ rje btsun rtse mos/ dung chos kyi chu thigs re bum pa kun du blugs pas gtso bo yab yum la sogs pa'i lha thams cad 'od du zhu bar bsgoms la mchod pas mchod do// zhes pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// slob ma sta gon la/ 'di pa'i lugs la myang 'das kyi bsam pa bskyed par ma bshad/ srung ba la rje btsun rtse mos mas rim dang yas rim gnyis ka bshad pa las/ khyed kyis yas rim kyi rim pa chad/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'i skabs su/ de nas dkyil 'khor khru gsum dang*// mthe bong gsum ni lhag par bya// zhes lung du drangs pa nor te/ lung 'di bdag med ma yi dkyil 'khor gyi tshad ston pa'i skabs yin gyi/ yab kyi ma yin te/ gal te yin na dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa'i tshad byas la zhes dang*/ gur du/ rdo rje can gyi khru gsum pa// zhes pa dang nang 'gal bar 'gyur zhing*/

lhag pa byas shes pa'i tshig la yang dpyad pa ma zhugs pa'o// dkyil 'khor bri zhing rgyan dgram pa tshar ba dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma byed pa nor te/ rje btsun rtse mos/ de ltar dkyil 'khor bri ba ni bgegs thams cad zhi bar bya ba dang*/ shis par bya ba'i phyir stangs stabs dang gtor ma rnams legs par bsdu ba nas 'byung ba ltar byas te/ zhes dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa bri tshar nas dkyil 'khor byin po bri ba'i bar chad zhi ba'i phyir gtong ba yin gyi/ bri tshar nas gtong ba min la/ gzhan rnams 'byung po kho na'i gtor mar byas nas lho sgo ba la/ thugs kyi rdo rje phyogs skyong ba// zhes dang*/ tsit+ta badz+ra sogs lha dang 'byung po tha mi dad du byed pa ni ches nor zhing*/ de dag gi mgron gyi bskyed chog rgyas par byed pa'ang*/ 'di pa'i lugs la bshad pa med la/ gal te byed na'ang a bha yā'i lugs/ zhwa lu ba'i lag len 'dis mi rung*/ slob dpon bha wa pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i 'grel par bshad pa'i don/ rje btsun rtse mos gnad kyi gsal byed du bkral ba ltar byed dgos so// bstod pa tshar nas nang mchod 'bul ba'ang nor te/ yongs bzung las/ nang zhugs thub dbang dpag med pa// hūm̐ byung rdo rje bcas pa'i lces// snying gar zla ba rgyas pa yi// dkyil 'khor ma lus tshim par bya// zhes dang*/ rje btsun rtse mos/ byin gyis brlabs la bdag nyid myang bar bya'o// zhes rang gi myang ba tsam bya ba yin gyi/ nang mchod rgyas par 'bul ba ni ma yin te/ yin na rol mo dang*/ na bza' dang*/ nang bdud rtsi dang*/ mchod pa nyi shu pa dang bstod pas kyang bstod la/ zhes pa dang nang 'gal bar 'gyur la/ man ngag lugs la yang de ltar bya dgos par 'gyur te/ dbang gi chu bor bstod pa'i mchod pa'o// de ltar mchod pa'i khyad par rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor mchod pas mnyes par byas la/ rang gi lce la bdud rtsi myangs la/

rang gi snying ga'i dkyil 'khor yang mnyes par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ bdag 'jug gi skabs su 'khyil pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i gos dmar po'i smad g.yogs dang*/ rak+ṣa haṃ gis stod g.yogs sbyin pa'ang nor te/ bzang po yongs bzung las/ de nas bla ma rdor 'dzin gyis// slob ma sdom pa dang ldan la// gos dmar gyon la mig ras kyis// mig dag dgab pa byas nas ni// zhes dang*/ rin chen 'bar ba las/ de nas slob ma gos dmar pos// gdong g.yogs me tog phreng bzung la// zhes dang*/ rdze btsun rtse mos/ slob dpon gos dmar po dang ldan pas/ rdo rje bzung bas slob ma la gos dmar po bskon te/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes bya bas gos dmar pos gdong g.yogs shing*/ zhes bshad pa dang 'gal te/ lung de dag las/ gos dmar dang mig ras sbyin par bshad kyi/ stod g.yogs smad g.yogs ma bshad la/ yo ga dang*/ phreng ba sogs nas bshad kyang*/ de dag 'dir shes byed du mi rung ngo*// sdug pa khyod ni su zhig yin// zhes sogs kyis dris lan byas nas dpral bar oṃ sogs kyi sku gsung thugs sbyang ba gong 'og nor te/ bzang po yongs bzung las/ sku gsum rnam par sbyang ba'i phyir// yi ge gsum po rnam par dgod// gsang sngags zlos zhing lag bzung nas// slob ma gzhug par bya ba yin// oṃ gi li gi li ma li gu ni ta badz+ra satwa tsa le yum yum yum swā hā/ slob ma gzhug pa'i sngags so// sdug pa khyod ni su zhig ces// bla mas slob ma la ni dri// zhes dang*/ rin chen 'bar ba las/ bsrung zhing sku gsung thugs sbyangs la// bu sdug khyod su ci la dga'// zhes dang*/ rje btsun rtse mos kyang*/ thog mar yi ge gsum gyis sbyangs nas/ dris lan bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// bud+dha pū dza sogs kyis phyag byas nas/ rnam snang du bskyed pa gong 'og nor te/ bzang po yongs bzung du/ de nas nang du bcug nas ni// rnam par snang mdzad sbyor byin la// sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs byas te// de nas dam tshig gzung bar bya// oṃ bud+dha pū dzo pa thā na ya sogs gsungs shing*/

rje btsun rtse mos kyang*/ slob ma de bdag med ma'i nga rgyal las rnam par snang mdzad du bskyed do// de nas slob mas oṃ bud+dha pū dzo pa thā na sogs gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// ye shes dbab pa'i rjes la/ man ngag lugs ltar tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par byed pa'ang nor te/ bzang po yongs bzung las/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma yā pra ti pa li ta hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho swā hā/ ye shes dbab pa las mi bskyod par bya ba'i sngags so// zhes dang rje btsun rtse mos/ babs pa de brtan par bya ba'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sogs dang*/ zhes bya ba brjod la dmigs pa gtod du gzhug go /zhes pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis gnas// sogs kyis gsol ba 'debs pa/ bzang po yongs bzung sogs ḍom+bi pa'i lugs kyi yi ge rnam dag las ma bshad/ sngon 'gro shis pa'i skabs su/ steng du gdugs dkar po zhes pa nor te/ rje btsun rtse mos steng du bla bre bres pa dang*/ g.yas su gdugs dkar po dang*/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa dang*/ zhes 'di dang man ngag lugs gnyis ka'i dkyil chog nas gsungs pa dang 'gal zhing*/ khyed kyis 'og rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gis skabs nas/ dbang stegs kyi steng na bla bre/ g.yas su hūm̐ las gdugs/ g.yon du oṃ las rgyal mtshan zhes bshad pa dang nang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// slob ma me tog gang la phog pa'i lhar bskyed de/ yungs kar dang chus sbyangs nas bkra shis byed pa'ang nor te/ bzang po yongs bzung dang*/ rin chen 'bar ba las/ dkyil 'khor gnyis pa slob ma gzhag /mchod yon zhabs bsil la sogs sbyin// sbyang ba'i cho ga byas nas ni// slob ma shis par 'dod pa'i phyir// bla mas bkra shis glur blang bya// zhes dang*/ rje btsun rtse mos/ dang por me tog gang phog gi lhar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ de la chu bzhi dbul/

de nas sbyang ba byas nas me tog sogs kyi mchod de bkra shis bya bar bshad pa las/ chu bzhi sogs kyi mchod pa rnams chad pa'i phyir ro// bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad kyang*/ sems can kun la phan 'byung mnga' ba po// la sogs pa rdo rje 'byung ba nas bshad pa ltar byed pa'ang nor te/ sh+lau ka bcu dgu'i bdag nyid can bkra shis de ni/ dpal mchog nas gsungs pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgo nyi shu rtsa lnga dang bstun nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzad pa nyi shu rtsa lngar bstan pa'i shis pa yin la/ 'dir ni/ bzang po yongs bzung 'grel pa ku mu ti/ rin chen 'bar ba gsum char du gur las gsungs pa mdzad pa brgyad dang bstun pa'i bkra shis sh+lau ka bcu gsum pa gsungs pas des bya bar rigs pa'i phyir ro// 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang la/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ zhes sogs kyis rdo rje sbyin pa nor te/ rje btsun rtse mos oṃ badz+ra a ral+li ho badz+ra ba ra ta ka hūm̐/ zhes brjod la slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par rdo rje gtad/ ces pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// brtul zhugs kyi rdo rje sems dpa' la zla gdan byed pa'ang nor te/ rdo rje sems dpa' mi bskyod pa'i rnam par bskyed pa'i phyir dang*/ rje btsun rtse mos nyi gdan du 'di dang man ngag lugs gnyis kyi dkyil chog tu bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// dbang bzhi ka'i mjug tu/ rje btsun rtse mos bshad pa'i sa du thob dang*/ brda' gang yin pa gnyis chad de/ gsang dbang gi skabs su a bha yā sogs kyis bshad pa ltar/ thog mar yab dang*/ de nas 'di ni bla na med sogs kyi yum gyi byang sems gnang bar byed pa'ang 'di'i lugs la shin tu nor te/ rje btsun rtse mos/ de nas de kho na nyid brjod par bya ste/ 'di ni de nyid bla na med// ces dbang gi de kho nar gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gal te bzang bzung dang*/ rin chen 'bar ba gnyis ka las/

dag pa'i lce yi mchog gis ni// gnyis ka las byung blang bar bya// zhes bshad do zhes lung de'i don ni/ yab yum so so'i byang sems ster ba ming gyi/ rje btsun rtse mos/ slob dpon yab yum gyi mkha' gsang nas byang chub kyi sems dung dang kun+da ltar dkar ba/ slob ma'i lce la bzhag par slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis kas bsgoms la/ zhes pa ltar gnyis ka'i byang sems yab kyi phyogs gcig tu/ gnang bas na yab la thob pa zhes su ming 'dogs pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na gnyis ka las byung zhes pa 'di mi 'thad par 'gyur/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye zhes sogs gsol ba gdab pa'ang nor te/ rin chen 'bar ba dang*/ rdze btsun rtse mos/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la sogs bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ḍom+bi he ru ka /des las brgyud pa'i smin grol tshul 'di la// ḍom+bi pa yi yab yum sgrub thabs dang*// mi thub zla ba'i ku mu ti dang ni// bzang po yongs bzung yan lag drug gsum dang*// dpa' bo rdo rje'i rin chen 'bar ba dang*// rje btsun rtse mo'i rnam bshad nyi 'od dang*// dkyil chog la sogs yang dag gzhung lugs yin// des na ḍom+bi'i rjes su 'jug pa rnams// gzhung bzang 'di dag rnams dang mi mthun na// rigs rus longs spyod gang gis che gyur pa// su yis bkral yang log pa'i lam du shes// de phyir deng sang phyag len mdzad rnams la/ rnam dag gzhung dang mthun pa ma mthong nas// mkhyen rab dbang phyug dpal ldan chos kyi rje// thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal// bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bor gus blangs pa// shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang po yis// bshes gnyen dam pa rnams la zhus pa yin// de yi dge ba dbang po'i rdo rje 'dis// lam log lha min dpung rnams pham byas te// lam bzang lha dbang rgyal mtshan rtser bzung nas// rim gnyis bdud rtsi'i dpal gyis 'byor par shog/
// ༄// 'phar ma gnyis kyi don bshad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti pra dzā bh+yaḥ'aphar ma gnyis kyi don pad ma 'dab brgyad nyis brtsegs la 'chad pa ni ma yin te/

bdag med ma lha mo bcu gsum ma'i skabs nas/ rdo rje gur las/ shar gyi sgo ni dkar chen mo'o// zhes dang*/ rje bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs su/ btsun chen pos shar sgor li zhes dang*/ shar gyi sgo ni dkar mo'o zhes sogs dang*/ ḍom+bi bdud rtsi 'od/ pas/ yang ni shar sgor dkar mo ste// de bzhin lhor ni chom rkun mo// nub kyi sgo la ro langs ma// zhes dang*/ gnyis med sgrub thabs las/ rdo rje'i/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po bsams te/ pad+ma'i nang shar phyogs la sogs pa'i 'dab ma bzhi dang*/ de bzhin du gzhal yas khang gi zur bzhi dang*/ sgo bzhi dang steng 'og rnams su ro bco lnga dang ldan par blta bar bya'o// zhes dang*/ de nas phyi rol gyi rim pa la dbang po la sogs pa'i mtshams su u/ ṛ ṝ lī'i dbyangs la sogs pa mi bskyod pa dang*/ rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ 'od dpag tu med pa'i rgyas btab pa/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung rnams kyi rang bzhin puk+ka sī dang*/ sha ba rī dang*/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang*/ ḍom+bi nī rnams bsgom par bya'o// de nas shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su i ī e ai'i dbyangs las byung ba puk+ka sī la sogs pa bzhin du rgyas btab pa/ gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro rnams kyis rang bzhin gau rī dang*/ tsau rī dang*/ be tā lī dang*/ ghasma rī rnams bsgom par bya'o// zhes dang*/ bka' 'grel mu tig phreng ba/ shān+ti pas/ phyi'i grwa mtshams su nyi ma la ū ṛ ṝ l̥̄ l̥̄'i shar la sogs pa'i sgo'i nyi ma la l̥̄ e ai o'o// zhes dang*/ mtshams rnams su puk+ka sī dang*/ ri khrod ma dang*/ gtum mo dang*/ g.yung mo'o// sgo rnams su chom rkun ma dang*/ ro langs ma dang*/ ghasma rī'o// zhes bshad pa yin/ rgyud dang rje btsun gong ma'i man ngag dang*/ rgya gzhung de dag las/

dkar mo la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad sgo mtshams su dgod par gsungs pa'i phyir 'dab brgyad phyi ma ni don med do// gzhan yang dbang gi chu bor/ 'phar ma gnyis par byed na rdo rje rwa ba sngon po me ri dmar ser du bya/ de nas lha rnams shar phyogs kyi sgo dkar po bya/ lhor ser po/ nub dmar po/ byang ljang gu/ 'phar ma gcig par byed na/ pad+ma chen po gcig gis sgo'i bar du khebs par byas nas/ de las rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ me ri byas kyang btub bo zhes gsungs kyi/ 'phar ma gnyis pa la 'dab brgyad nyis brtsegs byed par ma gsungs so// de nas 'phar ma gnyis kyi don ni/ nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'am bzhi pa la rdo rje rwa ba dang me 'od kyis bskor bas 'phar ma gcig dang*/ chos 'byung gru gsum pa'i nang du tshud pa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa ni 'phar ma gcig yin te/ bla ma gsal ba'i snying pos brtag gnyis kyi/ mnga' ris pa'i tshig 'grel las/ 'phar ma gnyis ni/ nang ma lha mo bdun gyi gnas la rdo rje rwa ba dang*/ me 'od kyis bskor ba phyi gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa'o// zhes gsungs la/ lha mo bdun gyi gnas zhes pa ni/ bsgom bya'i dbang du byas nas/ gtso mo'i steng 'og tu mkha' spyod ma dang sa spyod ma gnyis te bdun du mngon no// de bzhin du slob bka' 'grel pad+ma can las/ dpon mtsho skyes kyis kyang*/ gnyis brtsegs ni khang pa nyis rim mo// lte ba yis ni gcig yin te// zhes pa ni/ lte bas nye bar mtshon pas pad+ma ni dbus kyi pad+ma zhes bya ba'i don to// zur gsum gyis ni zhes bya ba ni chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis mtshon pas brtsegs ma gzhan gyi phyi rol phyi'i gau rī la sogs pa'i gnas su gru bzhi'o// zhes dang*/ slob dpon dam tshig bka' 'grel rin chen sbyor phreng las/ rdo rjes/ rim pa gnyis ni rim pa gnyis so// ze'u 'bru las gcig yin te/

zhes gsungs pa ni dbus kyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa ni rim pa dang po'o// gru gsum zhes gsungs pa ni/ gru gsum pa'i nang du tshud pa'i gru bzhi pa'o// zhes dang*/ grub thob bha wa bha dras/ 'phar ma gnyis bstan pa'i bshad pa gsungs pa/ ze'u 'bru las ni gcig gyur te// zhes pa la pad+ma la sogs pa las ma gtogs par ni ze'u 'bru 'byung ba ma yin no// des na pad+ma ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'bru zhes man ngag tu bstan to// nang gi 'phar mas ni gcig gyur pa'o// gru gsum gyis ni phyi mar brjod// ces pa ni chos 'byung gi nang du son pa gru gsum gyi rnam pa yin no// nam mkhar ston pa ni phyi ma ste phyi rol gyi 'phar ma nyid do// de yang gru bzhi pa la sogs pa dang 'chad par 'gyur ba'i thun mong gi mtshan nyid las so// zhes gsungs pas na rgya bod kyi shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po/ de rnams kyi dgongs pa ni bdag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pas gsal bar mdzad pa ltar yin la/ tshig gi cha de dag kyang bdag nyid chen po bsod nams rtse mo'i zhal snga nas kyi rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer du gsungs pa ltar bris pas na kha na ma tho ba ci yang med do// de'i phyir gzhan gyi blo gros legs bshad kyi rgya mtsho chen po la rang thos chung gi blos gzhal bar byed pa ni khron pa'i nya chung dang mtshungs pa yin no// gal te phyi'i 'phar ma gru bzhi dang*/ nang gi 'phar ma pad+ma la 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ nang gi 'phar ma la yang phyi'i 'phar ma lta bu'i gru bzhi pa yin pa la/ de nyid rdo rje phreng ba dang me 'od kyis bskor bas zur rnams bcad pa yin te/ slob bka' 'grel ku mu ti las dpon sbyang dka' zla bas/ 'phar ma gnyis zhes gsungs pa ni// kha sbyor lta bu'i 'phar ma ste// rdo rje phreng bas yongs su bcad pa dang sbas pa'o// zhes gsungs la/ kha sbyor ni gru bzhi pa yin te/

dpa' bo rdo rjes/ rin chen 'bar ba las/ kha sbyor gcig pa sgo bzhi pa// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro// gal te kha sbyor dang*/ 'phar ma dang rim pa sogs ni pad+ma la bya'i/ gru bzhi pa la bya ba ni ma yin no zhe na/ de la ni sngar bshad pa'i lung de dag gis kyang gnod la/ rgyud las kyang*/ 'phar ma gcig dang sgo bzhi pa// zhes yab kyi skabs su gsungs pa de'ang pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la 'chad par 'gyur ba'i skyon yod do// 'dod na gzhung de'i rjes kho na la/ de dbus pad+ma 'dab ma ni// brgyad pa ze bar bcas pa bri// zhes pa'i gzhung gong 'og la dpyad pa ma zhugs par zad la/ dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i gzhung gzhan las/ bde gshegs 'phar ma zhes gru bzhi pa la gsungs pa rnams kyang ma mthong ba yin no// yang steng 'og gi lha mo gnyis bsgoms pa'i tshe gtso mo'i steng 'og tu bsgoms la/ mtshan ma dgod pa'i tshe gang du bri na/ lots+tsha ba kha cig sam+bu ṭa las/ srid dang zhi ba'i rang bzhin gyis// ngos su bsgyur ma 'di dag gnas// zhes dang*/ de nyid gsum gyi rang bzhin bdag /mkhas pas dbus su bsgom par bya// zhes gsungs pas gtso mo'i g.yas g.yon du bri zhes smra mod kyi/ gzhung de'i bsgom bya'i skabs yin gyi/ bri bya'i skabs ma yin pa'i phyir/ slob dpon mtsho skyes kyi 'dir man ngag gi ro langs ma'i mtshan ma dang*/ nye bar mkha' spyod ma'o// zhes dang*/ dkyil slob dpon a bha yas/ chog rdo rje phreng bar/ mkha' spyod ma'i mtshan ma ni dkar mo'i phyi'i ngos su'o// ro langs ma'i phyi ngos su ni sa spyod ma'o// zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir dang*/ rgya bod kyi bla ma gong ma gang gis kyang de ltar ma bshad pa'i phyir mun sprul kho na yin la/ sam+bu ṭa'i lung shes byed du 'dren pa'ang sna bcad ma g.yar po'i rgyan chas mdzes par byas pa dang mtshungs so// des na lha mo 'di gnyis kyis mtshan ma steng gi shar sgo dang*/

'og gi nub sgor 'god pa phyag len yin zhing*/ rje btsun rtse mo dang*/ ne tso sbal ston sogs kyis kyang bshad pa ltar/ bdag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po nyid kyi zhal snga nas kyang gsal bar mdzad pa yin no// zhes pa 'di'ang blun po kha cig gi log rtog bsal ba'i don du/ 'di ni mkhyen rab dbang phyug chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos gus par len pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos smras// // ༄// mtsho skyes lugs kyi sgrub dkyil dang ḍom+bi lugs kyi sgrub dkyil gyi tho yig go/ ༈ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon chen po mtsho skyes rdo rje'i lugs kyi kye rdo rje nas gling mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ slob dpon rin po che'i man ngag lugs kyi mngon rtogs yan lag bzhi pa la gzhi byas nas/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams so sor byed pa phyag len yin te/ de'ang tshogs zhing nas snod bcud sbyang ba'i bar byas nas/ skye mched dang gnas gsum byin brlab byas/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs pa nas/ dbang gi lha la gsol ba gdab pa'i bar bya zhing*/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab kyi dbang gi mthar thug dran par rnams 'dir mi dgos/ lhag ma thams cad mngon rtogs rgyas pa yan lag bzhi pa ltar bya zhing*/ dkyil chog ni slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa ltar ro// 'di'i skabs su sgrub thabs mtsho skyes dang*/ dkyil chog nas gling ma tshad mar bzung ngo*// slob dpon ḍom+bi he ru ka'i lugs kyi kye rdo rje 'grel pa lugs su grags pa'i sgrub thabs rje btsun chen po man ngag lugs kyi mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa la bya zhing*/ der mi 'dra ba la/ yan lag gnyis pa'i skabs su/ bdag gis thog med dus nas ni// log rtog dbang gis sdig bgyis gang*// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag khyed rnams kyi// spyan sngar bshags bgyid slan chad bsdam// rgyal dang de yi sras rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i bsod nams ma lus la// de la yang dag yi rang zhing*// byang chub dam pa bsngo bar bgyi// gang dang gang gis 'dul gyur pa// de dang de yi skur ston cing*// sna tshogs gzugs nor lta bu yi// rdzogs sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi// kun rtog ma lus dag gyur cing*// rang rig yang dag ye shes bskyed// lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo nyid// dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi// go rim ji bzhin dbang bskur thob// ma nor lam la nges gnas pa'i// sras mchog 'khor 'dus dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag gi skyabs su mchi// yang dag ye shes me bo ches// gti mgu mun pa bsal ba dang*// sgrib pa ma lus sbyang ba'i phyir// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// rgyal sras dpa' bo rnams kyi lam// spyod pa dpag yas gang yin dang*// ma bcos ji bzhin lam gnas la// da ni yang dag gnas par bgyi// zhes pa bya/

tshad med bzhi nas mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa'i bar byas nas 'og gi a nu rā ga sogs 'dir brjod/ de nas 'bras bu rdor 'dzin nas snod bcud sbyang ba'i bar 'dra bar byas nas/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs nas dgug gzhug gi bar bya/ skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ de nas dbang gi lha spyan drangs pa nas gsol gdab kyi bar byas la rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab ste/ 'di la yang dbang gi mthar thug dran par bya ba rnams mi byed/ lhag ma thams cad mngon rtogs 'bring po yan lag drug pa ltar bya zhing*/ dkyil chog kyang slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa ltar ro// 'di'i skabs su sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa dang*/ dkyil chog bzang po yongs bzung gnyis tshad mar bya'o// slob dpon 'di gnyis kyi sgrub thabs su thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor ma bshad pas/ rje btsun gong mas srung 'khor mi mdzad par snang ngo*// tshul 'di rje btsun tho yig bzhin// kun dga' bzang po zhes bya bas// dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwar bris// dge bas rdo rje 'dzin thob shog/ ༈ //gzhal yas khang gi tshad rnam par gzhag pa'i zin bris/ rtsig pa'i dpangs ni rgya dpangs mnyam po dang*/ rgya phyed dpangs la sogs par bzhed pa mang yang*/ 'dir nor bu rin po che rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang*/ shin tu rnam par gnas pa'i gsang ba dam pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po las sa phyogs der rin po che sna bdun gyi khang pa brtsegs ma/ gru bzhi pa/ ka ba bzhi zug pa/ sgo bzhi btod pa/ mnyam pa/ nyams dga' ba/ shin tu rnam par phye ba/ ches mdzes par byas pa/ bkra ba/ lta na sdug pa/ 'od 'bar ba/ them skas bzhi dang ldan pa/ dpangs su dpag tshad gsum yod pa/ rgyar dpag tshad lnga yod pa zhig byung ngo*// zhes pa ste rgyas par logs su shes so// 'di ltar dkyil 'khor chen po yi// rtsig pa'i dpangs la cha chen bzhi// rin chen pha gu cha phran gcig

/drwa ba'i cha la cha phran gnyis// de steng gser gyi ska rags la// cha phran gcig gi lnga cha 'dod// phyogs mdog sa gzhi cha phran gcig /de steng ka ba cha chen bzhi// ka zhu la sogs shing brtsegs la// cha phran gcig gi lnga cha dang*// cha phran gcig du 'dod pa yin// de steng gdung zlum cha phran gcig /gdung zlum phyi ma'i thog rnams phub// gdung zlum steng du rtsig zlum dpangs// cha chen gcig dang cha phran gnyis// cha phran gcig gi sum gnyis ldan// pha gu cha phran sum cha dang*// drwa ba'i cha la cha phran gcig /de steng gdung bzhis mig mangs su// bres pa'i phyogs mtshams re mig brgyad// phub cing re mig dbus ma yi// gdung steng rtsig pa cha phran gsum// lnga chas dman pa'i cha phran gcig /pha gu cha phran sum cha ste// drwa ba cha phran sum gnyis yin// de steng mnyam po'i thog phub pa'i// rtse mor tog gis mdzes par bya// tshul 'di nor bu rgyas pa yi// gzungs kyi cho ga la brten nas// rgyud sde smra ba ā nan+das// zhib mor dpyad de bris pa yin// // ༄// sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi bsdus don bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ dgos 'dod kun 'byung rje btsun bla ma dang*// dbyer med dpal ldan kye yi rdo rje la// gus pas btud de de nyid sgrub pa'i tshul// rnal 'byor dbang po'i gzhung gi bsdus don bshad// 'dir gang bshad pa dang mnyan par bya ba'i chos ni/ sgrub pa'i thabs mtsho skyes zhes yongs su grags pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung chen po 'di yin no// 'di bshad par bya ba la gnyis/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung gi don no// dang po ni/ gzhung 'di gang gis mdzad na/ grub pa'i slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje ste/ rgyal po'i rigs zla ba'i thig le zhes bya bar gyur pa na 'khor ba'i chos la yid byung nas/ rdo rje theg pa'i chos 'tshol ba la u rgyan du byon pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas slob dpon chen po yan lag med pa'i rdo rje la man ngag nos shig

ces lung bstan thob nas/ slob dpon des rjes su bzung ste/ dpal kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa thams cad gnang zhing rtogs pa skyong ba'i grogs las kyi phyag rgyar slob dpon nyid kyi bu mo yang byin no// der slob dpon gyi bu mo dang lhan cig rim pa gnyis kyi kun spyod skyong gin bzhugs pa na// yul de'i blon po rnams kyis 'di 'dra ba mi legs so// zhes gleng nas/ yul de'i rgyal po la zhus/ rgyal pos slob dpon nyid la dris pas cang mi gsung ngo*// der 'bangs rnams kyis tsan+dan smug po'i mer slob dpon phyag rgya dang bcas pa bsregs pas/ rgyal po'i thugs dgongs la slob dpon bsregs pa'i nyes pa nga la'ang 'ong snyam nas mi dgyes pa gyur cing*/ tsha tsha gdab par dgongs nas gdung rus sdud pa la byon pas/ thal ba'i dkyil na mtsho chung ngu 'dug pa'i nang na pad+ma chen po kha zum pa zhig 'dug nas/ ngo mtshar te de'i kha phyes tsa na slob dpon phyag rgya mo dang bcas pa bzhugs pa gzigs nas/ rgyal po 'bangs dang bcas pa thams cad dad par gyur nas/ slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes bya ba mtshan du btags so// de lta bu'i grub pa thob pa'i slob dpon des mdzad de/ rgyud gang la brten nas mdzad na/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa la brten no// gang mdzad na dpal kye rdo rje phyag bcu drug pa dang*/ he ru ka gzhan gsum gyi mngon rtogs ston pa sku bzhi lam byed kyi sgrub thabs 'di dang*/ rgyud kyi 'grel pa pad+ma can la sogs pa gzhung drug go /dgos pa ci'i phyir du mdzad na/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems can gyi kye rdo rje'i rgyud don la slob cing nyams su len pa rnams kyis sku bzhi'i go 'phang 'thob par bya ba'i phyir du mdzad do// zhes shes par bya'o// gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum/ sgrub thabs la 'jug pa klad kyi don/
sgrub thabs dngos/ sgrub pa mthar phyin pa mjug gi don no// dang po la gsum/

rgya mtshan dang*/ mchod par kyai brjod pa dang*/ bshad par gsum pa dam bca' ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ gang gis sgom pa'i gang zag dang por/ gang bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor ro// 'di la gnyis/ rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i go rims dang*/ sgrub thabs dngos so// 'di la gnyis/ tshogs gnyis bsag pa dang*/ lha bsgom pa dngos so// dang po la gnyis/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsag dngos po/ pa'o// dang po la gsum/ tshogs bsag pa'i zhing spyan drangs pa/ mchod cing rgyun bshags bya ba/ tshad med sems can thams cad/ bzhi bsgoms pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ mchod pa dang rgyud de'i mdun du/ dag pa'o// 'di la lnga/ sdig pa bshags de'i spyan sngar/ pa/ rjes su yi gang gis rang ba/ bla na med pa/ yongs su bsngo ba/ skyabs de nas/ su 'gro ba/ sems bskyed sems can rnams/ pa'o// gnyis pa lha bsgoms pa la gnyis/ phyag bcu drug pa'i mngon rtogs dang*/ he ru ka gsum gyi mngon rtogs so// dang po la gnyis/ mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ mnyam par ma gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po la gsum/ srung ba'i 'khor de nas smon lam/ lo// gzhal yas khang bsgom pa/ lha bskyed pa'o// gnyis pa la bzhi/ gzhi yi yan lag de yis/ rgyu'i yan lag de'i steng du/ rkyen gyi yan lag de'i/ gnas des bdag thabs kyi yan lag go /gsum pa la gnyis/ gnas pa bzhi'i rim pas sgom tshul/ thun bzhi'i sgo nas sgom de ltar du/ tshul lo// dang po la bzhi/ longs sku'i bdag nyid gong bur gnas pa/ chos sku'i bdag nyid chur de ma thag gnas pa/ sprul sku'i bdag nyid yang nam mkha'/ gzugs su gnas pa/ ngo bo sku'i/ nyid kyi bdag nyid gzugs las 'das par gnas pa'o// dang po la gsum/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang bskyed de'i/ pa/ mkha' de nas/ gsang byin gyis brlab pa/

'khor de nas bsrubs pa/ gyi lha mo dbyung ba'o// gsum pa la bzhi/ dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa/ gzhung bsdu bcom ldan 'das/ ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ lha mo bzhis glus bskul de nas puk+ka sī sogs/ ba dang*/ de las 'bras bdag nyid/ bu rdo rje 'dzin bzhengs pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ sngon 'gro snod bcud rang gi snying gar/ sbyang ba/ dngos gzhi ye shes pa dgug yang nam mkha'/ pa'o// gsum pa la gsum/ dbang bskur gyi rang gis blo/ lha spyan drangs shing mchod pa/ dbang bskur 'di skad du ba dngos/ rigs kyi bdag pos dbang bskur nas/ rgyas gdab pa'o// bzhi pa la drug dkyil 'khor bsdu de ltar ba/ 'khor lo bzhis rgyas gdab pa/ de ltar 'khor lo thabs/ phyag 'khor lo/ rgya drug gi go cha bya/ skye mched drug byin gyis brlab de'i 'od zer/ rdzogs rim gyi nus pa sgrub de ltar/ pa'i bzlas pa/ mar de nas rang gi me'i rtse mo sgom tshul lo// gnyis pa mnyam par ma gzhag pa la bzhi/ aṣ+ṭa/ bzlas pa'i sngags/ gtor oṃ in+d+ra/ ma'i sngags/ las tshogs kyi sngags/ a ka ro/ thun byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags gcig pu/ so// gnyis pa he ru ka gzhan gsum gyi mngon rtogs la gnyis/ mnyam par gzhag pa dang*/ mnyam par ma gzhag pa'o// dang da ltar/ po la gnyis/ thun gyi cho ga dang*/ so so'i mtshan nyid do// 'di la gsum/ sku rdo rje'i mngon phyag gnyis pa/ rtogs/ gsung rdo de bzhin du rje'i mngon rtogs/ thugs de bzhin du phyag drug rdo rje'i mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa la bzhi/ bzlas pa'i oṃ tra/ sngags/ spyod lhag ma/ lam gyi rnal 'byor/ dag pa dran snying rje/ pa/ smon lam gdab pa'o/ smon lam/ /gsum pa sgrub pa mthar phyin pa mjug gi don la bzhi/

brtsams pa'i nongs blo chung*/ pa bzod par gsol ba/ brtsams gang zhig pa'i nus pa/ yod par bstan pa/ brtsams pa'i dge kye rdo rje/ ba bsngo ba/ gzhung thams cad rdzogs par bstan pa'o// 'di la gnyis/ mdzad pa po'i slob dpon smos slob dpon/ pa/ bsgyur ba po'i lo rgya gar/ paṇa smos pa'o// gong ma'i bsdus don rnam bshad rgyas pa las// tshig nyung don gsal rtogs par sla ba yi// bsdus don shin tu gsal bar sbyor cig ces// phun tshogs bsod nams chen po'i dpal mnga' zhing*// dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma'i gsung tshab mchog /mkhyen dang brtse ba'i rgyal mtshan mngon mtho bas// thub bstan dpal 'byor bzang po skyong mdzad pa// mi dbang chos kyi bla ma 'gro ba'i rje// gang gis bka' yis bskul ba khur blangs nas// 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhabs rdul gus blangs pa// shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos bris// dge des 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo// i daṃ shā sa nash+tsa sarba satwa hi to bha wan+tu// // ༄// dpal kye rdo rje'i bstod pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal kye rdo rje la bstod pa'i rnam bshad mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog ces bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang sku tshogs gnyis rgyas pa'i chu gter las// rnam dkar las kyi 'dab stong smin pa'i rtser// dge legs dpal 'byor snying po'i ge sar can// dpal ldan mtsho skyes rdo rje la phyag 'tshal// gang gi gsung rab yon tan gter// lan gcig brjod na'ang dpal 'phel zhing*// 'dod lhas byin gyis rlob byed pa// de yi rnam bshad gsal bar bri// 'dir dpal kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la bstod pa/ pad+ma la brdzus te 'khrungs shing mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i bha ta ra'i bstod pa nyi shu par grags pa'i 'di bshad par bya ba la/

klad dang*/ gzhung dang*/ mjug gi don gsum gyi dang po ni/ rgya gar du/ he badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la stot+t+ra nā ma/ bod skad du/ kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal kye rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes te go sla'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ bstod pa dngos dang*/ de'i dge ba bsngo ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ bskyed rim ltar bstod pa dang*/ rdzogs rim ltar bstod pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ gtso bo la bstod pa dang*/ 'khor rnams la bstod pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ chos sku'i sgo nas bstod pa/ ngo bo nyid sku'i sgo nas bstod pa/ longs sku'i sgo nas bstod pa/ sprul sku'i sgo nas bstod pa'o// dang po ni/ rgyud las// brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos po gang*// rtswa lcug 'khri shing la sogs pa// bdag gi dngos po'i rang bzhin las// dam pa'i de nyid nges bsgom bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar brtan g.yo'i dngos po thams cad kyi rang bzhin nam/ ngo bo ni de bzhin nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid de/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub sems// bdag dang phung po rnams rig gi /rtog pa rnams kyis ma bsgribs shing*// rtag tu stong nyid mtshan nyid bzhed// ces dang*/ dbu ma rtsa bar/ gzhan las shes min zhi ba dang*// spros pa rnams kyis ma spros pa// rnam rtog med don tha dad min// de ni de yi mtshan nyid do// ces pa ltar de nyid ni chos gzhan las mchog tu chos kyi sku'am/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes bya la/ de gdod ma nas/ nga las 'gro ba thams cad 'byung*// nga las gnas gsum po yang byung*// nga yis 'di kun khyab pa ste// 'gro ba'i rang bzhin gzhan ma mthong*// zhes pa ltar/ dngos po thams cad kyi bdag nyid dam rgyu'am khyab byed du yang dag par gnas pa yin te/ rgyud las/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas// rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs// dngos po kun la khyab pa po// lus gnas lus las ma skyes pa'o// zhes pa ltar ro// de bzhin nyid dam/

chos kyi sku'i don yang snang grag gi dngos po thams cad rang bzhin gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo nyid dang bral ba rnam par dpyad pa'i stong pa nyid med dgag tsam yin la/ de dang sangs rgyas kyi chos sku gnyis stobs sogs bral 'bras kyi yon tan yod med tsam ma yin pa gzhan khyad par med pa yin te/ dbu ma bden gnyis las/ 'di ltar snang ba'i dngos po la// rigs pas brtags na 'ga' mi rnyed// ma rnyed pa de don dam ste// ye nas gnas pa'i chos nyid do// zhes so// des na gnad 'di ma go bar/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid de chen po'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten khams 'dir gzhan yod min// zhes sogs kyi lung la brten nas las nyon gyi 'ching ba kun ldan kyi so skye dang*/ tshogs gnyis mthar phyin gyi sangs rgyas gnyis glo bur gyi dri ma dag ma dag ma gtogs khyad par cung zad kyang med cing*/ stobs sogs bral 'bras kyi yon tan rnams kyang yod par smra ba ni thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa la phyin ci log tu gyur pa yin te/ rgyud blar/ rigs yod phyir na lus can kun// rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can// zhes rigs sogs yod par bshad kyi/ sangs rgyas dngos yod par ma bshad la/ stobs sogs bral 'bras kyi yon tan yod pa dang*/ glo bur gyi dri ma ma dag pa'ang 'gal te/ rgyud blar/ stobs nyid ma rigs sgribs la rdo rje bzhin// zhes dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel chen du'ang*/ gang gi tshe bdud yod pa de'i tshe sangs rgyas nyid ma yin te/ sems sgrib pa dang bcas pa'i phyir ro// gang gi tshe sangs rgyas nyid yin pa de'i tshe bdud med de/ sems sgrib pa dang bral ba'i phyir ro// zhes dang*/ bdud ces bya ba ni sems can rnams kyi 'khor ba'i sems kyi bag chags kyi dri ma'o// sangs rgyas nyid ces bya ba'i don ni/ 'khor ba'i bag chags dang bral ba'i sems so// zhes dang*/ de'i phyir bdud ni dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems yin la/

sangs rgyas ni dri ma med pa'i sems yin no// zhes sogs dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// 'o na sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid de chen po'i sangs rgyas zhes sogs kyi don gang zhe na/ rgyud blar/ de bzhin nyid ni thams cad la// khyad par med kyang dag gyur pas// zhes pa ltar khams rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs la khyad par med par ston pa'i lung yin/ so skye la yon tan dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas yod par 'chad pa ma yin te/ dus 'khor 'grel chen nyid du/ rdo rje sems dpa' stobs bcu par gyur pa sgrib pa dang bcas pa shes rab yongs su dag pa ni 'ga' yang med do// 'on kyang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam nyams pa de ni log pa'i nga rgyal gyis zil gyis mnan par gyur pa na bdag kyang rdo rje sems dpa' stobs bcu pa'o// zhes de ltar rlom par byed do// 'di ni stobs bcu pa ma yin te/ stobs bcu pa'i 'gal zla nyi tshe ba rmongs pa chen po'o// 'dir rnal 'byor pa 'di yi sangs rgyas nyid ni sngon med pa shin tu rmad byung chen po ste/ sgrib pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i phyir ro// zhes dang*/ rnal 'byor pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su mi 'gyur te/ gang gi phyir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba med pa'i phyir dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan pa med pa'i phyir ro// zhes sogs du ma gsungs pa dang nang 'gal ba'i skyon 'byung ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ thabs ni kye zhes pa'i don ni snying rje ste/ 'di la sems can la dmigs pa/ chos la dmigs pa/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje gsum las/ 'dir brjod bya'i gtso bo sems can dang chos su rnam par mi rtog pa'i dmigs med kyi snying rje mthar thug pa ste/ 'dis zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' gnon te/ byams pas/ bdag sred ma lus shes rab kyis bcad nas// sems can sred phyir brtse ldan zhi thob min// de ltar blo brtse byang chub thabs bstan nas// 'phags pa 'khor ba'am mya ngan 'da' mi 'gyur// zhes pa lta bu'i thabs dang*/

shes rab ni rdo rje zhes pa'i don to// ji ltar rdzas kyi rdo rjes phar la dngos po thams cad 'joms la/ tshur gang gis kyang bshigs par mi nus pa de bzhin du/ shes rab stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug pa 'dis kyang phar mtshan ma dang rtog pa thams cad 'joms la/ tshur gang gis kyang bshig par mi nus pa ste/ rdo rje rtse mor/ sra zhing snying po khong stong med// bcad dang gzhig par bya ba med// bsreg par byar med 'jig med par// stong pa nyid ni rdo rjer brjod// ces so// 'dis srid pa 'khor ba'i mtha' mnan pa'o// thabs shes rab de gnyis po'ang zag pa med pa'i dbyings su dper na mar me'i snang ba dang*/ dro mdog so so ma yin pa ltar gnyis su med par gyur pa ltar/ rgyur blar/ dri med gnas la mngon shes dang*// ye shes dri med de nyid ni// rnam dbyer med phyi mar me yi// snang dang dro mdog chos mtshungs can// zhes so// de ltar thabs shes chu la chu bzhag pa'am/ mar la mar thim pa ltar gnyis med du gyur pa'i kye rdo rje ste/ rgyud las/ hes ni snying rje chen po nyid// badz+ra'ang shes rab brjod par bya// thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rgyud// ces te/ de lta bu la mtsho skyes rdo rje sogs rnal 'byor pa thams cad phyag 'tshal lo zhes so// gsum pa ni/ gang zag dang chos kyi bdag gis stong pa ni lha mo bdag med ma ni mgul nas 'khyud cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gong nas gong du rgyas pa'i phyir dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing rnam thar brgyad dag pa'i zhal brgyad dang ldan pa la sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum dag pas spyan gsum dang ldan pa'i mgon po kye rdo rje de la mtsho skyes rdo rje bdag phyag 'tshal/ zhes so// bzhi pa la bzhi/ zhal gyi sgo nas bstod pa/ phyag gi sgo nas bstod pa/ zhabs sogs kyi sgo nas bstod pa/ rgyan gyis sgo nas bstod pa'o// dang po ni/

spyi bo dang zhal gzhan rnams dang steng zhal ni bdud skrag par byed pas nag po mdzes par byas pa/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bas dkar po dang sems can gyi don la rjes su chags pas dmar po ni go rim bzhin g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal gnyis kyi kha dog yin la/ de las gang gi lhag pa'i rgyab zhal rnams ni bung ba ltar gnag pa de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ zhes pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ g.yas kyi phyag mtshan gyi sgo nas bstod pa/ g.yon gyi phyag mtshan gyi sgo nas bstod pa'o// dang po ni/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal kha/ drug pa na skye pa ste mi dmar po/ bdun pa na khyi nag po/ brgyad pa na me he sngon po 'dzin pa can te/ phyag mtshan 'og ma gnyis/ rgyud las sha ra bha ste seng ge gshog pa can dang*/ byi lar bshad pa dang mi mthun mod/ slob dpon nyid kyis sgrub thabs las kyang 'di bzhin du bshad pas slob dpon 'di bzhed par mngon no// phyag mtshan de dag rnams g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad kyi mthil la gnas pa'i stong nyid cha bcu drug gi rang bzhin thod pa 'dzin pa la bdag phyag 'tshal/ zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang gu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na gsang ba pa ste/ nor bdag ser po rnams phyag g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ zhes pa'o// gsum pa ni/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dag pa'i zhabs bzhi pos ni phung sogs bdud bzhi po'i rang bzhin gzugs khams kyi tshangs pa ser po sogs lha chen bzhi mnyam par mnan cing chos kyi dbyings la sgrib pa'i skyon las grol bas sku gcer bu ste 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos pas gdan nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs tshul dang*/

byams pa'i thugs las mi 'gyur bas sku mdog sngon po bde ba chen po'i gar gyis rol par mdzad pa de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ kha cig nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang dang bskum/ zhes par bsgyur nas zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum dang*/ gar mdzad ces pas rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i gar du 'dod/ de ltar na g.yas brkyang ba'i brla la g.yon bskum nas sbyar ba'i gar mdzad ces par bshad du rung mod/ dpe rnying pa thams cad la sngo zhes par yod la/ 'di med na/ bstod pa 'dir gtso bo'i kha dog ma bstan pa'i skyon yod do// zhes pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo lnga bcus rnam par brgyan zhing*/ ltag pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lnga rnam par dag pa'i spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo sogs phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ phrin las sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pas sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin cing dpral ba'i thad kyi dbu rgyan gyi rtse mor rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pas mdzes par byas pa/ mi bslu bas dam pa yin la dga' ba ni bde ba yin te/ bslu ba med pa'i rigs 'di don dam pa yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i mi 'gyur zhing mi bslu ba'i don dam 'gyur med kyi bde ba yang dag par thob pa'i bde ba chen po he ru ka de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ zhes pa'i don to// gnyis pa la gnyis/ so so la bstod pa/ spyi la bstod pa'o// dang po ni/ 'khor gyi lha mo'i bstod pa 'di dag shin tu go sla bas gcig shes pas kun shes pas na thog mar gcig la mtshon na/ sa bon ni gang*/ lha mo'i ming ni ci/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs ni gang na gnas/ sku mdog ni ji lta bu/ phyag mtshan ni gang*/ gdan ni ci la bzhugs/ zhes drug drug gis go bar bya ba las/ sa bon gaṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mtshan gau rī'am dkar mo zhes pa dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs shar du gnas pa sku mdog ste yan lag gnag cing phyag mtshan phyag g.yon na nya ro hi ta zhes pa nya dmar po dang*/

g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin/ gdan tshangs pa mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes pa ste/ de bzhin du 'og ma mdun la yang drug drug gi sgo nas bstod pa'o/ 'dir kha cig lha mo rnams kyi phyag mtshan g.yon pa rnams dang po smos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ lha mo rnams shes rab yin la/ phyag g.yon yang shes rab kyi phyogs yin pas so// zhes smra ba yang rigs pa ma yin te/ de ltar na dkyil 'khor gzhan gyi lha mo rnams la'ang 'byung dgos pa las de ltar ma byung ba'i phyir dang slob dpon nyid kyi sgrub thabs su'ang g.yon nas thog mar smos dgos pa la ma smos pa'i phyir ro// des na g.yon nas thog mar smos pa ni/ sdeb sbyor dang 'gyur gyi dbang gis yin gyi/ thams cad du ma nges te/ ghasma rī'i skabs nas/ phyag gnyis sbrul dang thod pas sbrel// zhes g.yas thog mar smos pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la gsum/ rnam 'gyur dang rgyan gyi sgo nas bstod pa/ rnam dag gi sgo nas bstod pa/ bskyed chog gi sgo nas bstod pa'o// dang po ni skyil krung sogs te go sla'o// gnyis pa ni/ phyogs kyi lha mo/ gzugs/ tshor ba/ 'du shes/ 'du byed de/ phung po dang mtshams kyi lha mo/ sa chu me rlung ste khams bzhi po rnams rnam par dag cing*/ gtso bo yab yum gyi byang chub kyi sems las byung ba'i bde ba rab dang mchog tu gyur pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rnal 'byor pa rnams la ster ba'i lha mo brgyad po 'di thams cad la/ phyi nang gi dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin shes pa'i sgo nas de kho na nyid kyi phyag 'tshal zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ lha mo brgyad po nyid kyis g.yas kyi phyag na bzung ba'i phyag mtshan gri gug dang ḍā ma ru sogs brgyad dang*/ gaṃ tsaṃ sogs sa bon brgyad las skyes pa'i bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'dod pa thams cad la dus rtag tu ste bar ma chad par gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/

bskyed chog gang zhig 'og gi nyi ma dang steng gi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kha sbyor ba'i bar du gnas pa'i sa bon hūm̐ dang aṃ gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo dang*/ rig ma bdag med ma dang bcas pa nyid kyi nyid kyi zhes pa snga ma yab dang phyi ma yum la sbyor bar mngon pas yab yum nyid kyi dkyil 'khor 'di las 'od 'phros pas ni 'dod pa gzugs gzugs med pa'i 'jig rten gsum po snang ba ste gsal bar mdzad pa dang ldan zhes te/ gtso bo yab yum gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas khams gsum gyi snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud thams cad lhar gsal bar byas zhes pa'i don to// gtso bo yab yum nyid kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pa las khams gsum po 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa dang rnam rtog rnams zhi ba'i bde ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes stsol bar mdzad pa ni stong pa nyid de der sdud cing*/ der ma zad gau rī sogs rig ma brgyad po rnams stong nyid kyi dbyings der sdud par mdzad pa yin la/ der ma zad mthar shes rab stong pa nyid dang bdud rtsi'i ro bde ba chen po ste/ de dag la chags pa bcom ldan 'das nyid kyang spros med kyi/ gnas su sam+bu ṭar/ dmigs med gnas su shes rab dang*// dmigs med snying rje chen po nyid// blo dang lhan cig gcig gyur pas// nam mkhar nam mkha' ji lta bu// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ zhi ba bcom ldan 'das de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes de sdud rim gyi sgo nas so// gnyis pa ni/ gau rī sogs mkha' 'gro ma brgyad kyi gtso bo kye rdo rje dang*/ de'i rig ma lha mo bdag med ma dang*/ 'khor gau rī sogs dang bcas pa la bstod pa'i mtsho skyes rdo rje bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa des ni 'jig rten gsum gyi sems can thams cad kye rdo rje de dang mtshungs par shog cig ces pa'i don to// gsum pa mjug ni/ dpal kye rdo rje la bha ra ta'i bstod pa nyi shu pa slob dpon mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so//

//rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang*/ dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba'o// //zhes pa'i 'di ni go sla'o// bdag blo rgyud 'grel chu gter las// bstod pa'i rnam bshad me tog phreng*// mkhas kun dga' ba'i 'dab stong ldan// legs bshad ze 'brus mdzes 'di 'khrungs// 'di sbyar dge ba ston ka'i zla ba des// don gnyer blo yi mun pa sel ba dang*// mtha' yas yon tan cha shas yongs rdzogs nas// dge legs ri bong mtshan mas mdzes gyur cig /bstod pa'i rnam par bshad pa mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog ces bya ba 'di ni/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi ring lugs pa rnams kyi rgyal po chos kyi rje ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang po la blo gsal mang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal sa skya yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas su sbyar ba'o// // ༄// dpal kye rdo rje mtsho skyes lugs kyi dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i cho ga tshogs gnyis rgyas byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i cho ga tshogs gnyis rgyas byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dam pa rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'dab brgya'i lte bar rta bdun gdan dang bdud kyi snying gar bcom ldan 'das// rnam thar zhal dang stong nyid phyag ldan bsdu dngos zhabs kyis gar mdzad pa// ma brgyad mkha' 'gro'i gtso la btud de de yi dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i tshul// grub pa'i dbang phyug mtsho skyes zhabs kyi dgongs pa ji bzhin 'dir bshad bya// legs bsham bskyed dang maṇ+ḍal bsgrub// phyag 'tshal mchod dang rgyun bshags bya// smon lam btab dang bzod par gsol// gshegs gsol mjug ste rnam pa bcu// de la dang po mchod pa bshams pa'i phyir/ sngags pas tho rangs snga bar ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis ldang ste/ bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro na khrus kyi rnal 'byor yang byas la/

yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ phyag dar dang*/ skyang nul bya/ maṇ+ḍal khru gang las mi chung ba'i sa gzhir ba byung lnga dang*/ dri bzang pos byug pa'i maṇ+ḍal byas la/ der maṇ+ḍal gyi g.yas/ rang gi g.yon nas g.yas skor du rin po che'i snod dam dung chos la sogs par chu dang dri bzang sbyar ba'i zhabs bsil dang*/ chu dang 'o ma sbyar ba'i zhal bsil dang*/ chu la me tog mang po btab pa'i mchod yon te/ chu gsum dang*/ maṇ+ḍal gyi g.yon/ rang gi g.yas su g.yon skor gyis/ me tog spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas te nyer spyod lnga dang*/ mdun du bzed zhal yang bsham/ rang gi mdun du rang la ltos pa'i g.yon nas/ thod pa ma da nas bkang ba la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa dang*/ rdo rje dril bu dang*/ dung chos su dri bzang po'i chu la las thams cad pa'i sngags mang du bzlas pa'i bsang chu ku sha'i 'thor yab dang bcas pa bzhag par bya'o// de nas gnyis pa bsrung ba bya ba'i phyir/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ yi ge zla ba'i gzi brjid ltar dkar ba/ de las 'od 'phros pas lus thams cad gang*/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs te/ stong par gyur/ de'i ngang las hūm̐ las rang nyid las kyi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bsams la/ de'i spyi bor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ dkar po/ lkog mar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa la āḥdamar po/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ sngon po rnams bltas la/ oṃ āḥrak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum brjod pas/ gnas dang*/ bdag dang*/ rnal 'byor gsum bsrung bar bya'o// de nas gsum pa maṇ+ḍal sgrub pa'i phyir/ bdud rtsi lnga dang dri bzangs sam ba 'byung lnga la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas bsngags shing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba ta thā ga ta bi sho dha ni badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes pas chu la bsngags nas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su bzhag la/ lag pa g.yas mtheb mdzub kyis me tog bzung ste/

dbus nas dbang ldan du 'then la/ g.yas bskor du khyem med par byug cing*/ oṃ badz+ra re khe hūm̐/ zhes brjod pa la lag pa ma btegs par maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su me tog dor nas/ lag pa bshal la thal mo sbyar te// chu bcas lci ba sbyin pa yin// skyang nul byas pa tshul khrims yin// grog mo sogs bsal bzod pa yin// bya ba brtsams pa brtson 'grus yin// skad cig rtse gcig bsam gtan yin// ri mo mnyam par shes rab yin// thub pa'i maṇ+ḍal byas pas pha rol phyin drug rnyed par 'gyur// lha mi khyad par can skye zla ltar zil 'phags shing*// nad kun las grol gser gyi mdog dang 'dra bar 'gyur// rgyal rigs 'bru dang gser sogs 'byor par ldan par skye// bde nas bde gshegs mchog gi khyim du lus las bya// zhes phan yon brjod nas lag pa g.yon pa maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su reg la/ oṃ badz+ra me di nī badz+ra bha wa badz+ra ban+dha hūm̐/ zhes pas sa gzhi de sna tshogs rdo rjer bsam/ gzhung du de las ma bshad la/ bla ma dag phan yon brjod pa'i rjes su/ maṇ+ḍal bsang sbyangs byas la/ der thun mong gi srung 'khor nas/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa'i bar/ bdag bskyed ltar mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis bskyed pa phyag len la mdzad pas grub na bya'o// maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dri'i thig le gru bzhi pa dang*/ me tog gi tshom bu bkod cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ na maḥzhes brjod de/ de bzhin du phyogs bzhi dang mtshams bzhir yang dri'i thig le zlum po re dang*/ me tog gi tshom bu dgod cing*/ shar du gaṃ badz+ra gau rī na maḥ lhor tsaṃ badz+ra tsau rī na maḥ nub tu baṃ badz+ra be tā lī na maḥ byang du gaṃ badz+ra ghasma rī na maḥ dbang ldan du paṃ badz+ra puk+ka sī na maḥ mer shaṃ badz+ra sha ba rī na maḥ bden bral du laṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa lī na maḥ rlung du ḍaṃ badz+ra ḍom+bi nī nā maḥ zhes brjod la/ lha de dang der dran pa tsam bya ba'am/ bla ma dag mtshan sngags de rnams las so sor zhal phyag gsal btab pa skye mched byin gyis rlobs pa rnams phyag len la mdzad pas grub na bya'o// de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa can 'phros/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i pad+ma la bsnun pa tsam gyis thugs rgyud bskul te/ sangs rgyas thams cad rje btsun kye rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par sprul nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsams la/ hūm̐ bzhis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dza/ zhes sgrub thabs nas bstan par ltar dgug gzhug bcing dbang du byas la/ yi ge brgya pa brjod pas brtan par bya'o// bla ma dag dgug gzhug gi rjes la/ dbang bskur gyi lha spyan drangs pa nas rgyas gdab pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar byas nas/ yi ge brgya pa brjod pa phyag len la mdzad pas grub na bya'o// de nas bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba'i phyir/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// ces sogs kyis bla ma dang*/ gti mug gis mnan 'gro gzigs te// 'gro ba gti mug zhi bya'i phyir// rdo rje can gyi gau rī mdzad// de bas gau rīr bstod phyag 'tshal// zhe sdang gis mnan 'gro gzigs nas// 'gro ba zhe sdang zhi bya'i phyir// rdo rje can gyi tsau rī mdzad// de bas tsau rīr phyag 'tshal bstod// nga rgyal gyis mnan 'gro gzigs nas// 'gro ba nga rgyal zhi bya'i phyir// gtso bo be tā lī gzugs mdzad// de bas be tā līr phyag bstod// 'dod chags kyis mnan 'gro gzigs nas// 'gro ba 'dod chags zhi bya'i phyir// gtso bo ghasma rī gzugs mdzad/ de bas ghasma rīr bstod 'dud/ bdag med ma dang gnyis med gzugs// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum bdag /rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal// zhes brjod cing*/ tsau rīs zhe sdang sbyang ba sogs sbyang gzhi gzhan dang mi mthun par bshad pa ni gtso che chung gi dbang du byas par mngon no// lnga pa bstod pa bya ste/ sngags dang phyi nang yid las byung*// bla med bstod pa'i mchod pa'o// de nas sngags kyis mchod pa bya ba'i phyir// oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

zhes pas bcom ldan 'das dang*/ oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ zhes pas bcom ldan 'das ma dang*/ oṃ aṣ+ṭā na na ya na maḥ piṃ gaur+dha ke sha warta ma ne na maḥ oṃ tsa tur rbiṃ sha ti ne trā ya na maḥ oṃ ṣo ḍa sha bhū dzā ya na maḥ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa dzī mu ta wa pu ṣe na maḥ oṃ ka pa la ma la ne ka dha ri ṇai na maḥ oṃ adh+ma ta kru ra tsit+tā ya na maḥ oṃ ar+dhen+du daṃ ṣ+ṭi ṇe na maḥ zhes rkang pa brgyad kyis mchod de/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ ku sha'i 'thor yab kyi rtses bsang chu bangs pa des mchod pa rnams la gtor zhing*/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i thod pa'i nang du hūm̐ brgyad zhu ba las/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhabs bsil/ mchod yon/ me tog bdug pos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang*/ gos zung la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab par mos nas/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes pas dpag tu med par bsam mo// de nas thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i// sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// rnam lnga 'dod bskor bya zhing*/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wa ra/ zhes pas mchod yul gsal gdab/ lag pa g.yas khu tshur las mtheb mdzub brkyang ba rtse sprad la g.yas su bskor zhing*/ gyen du bstan la mdzub mo nas rim par bkrol nas/ oṃ badz+ra nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ/ zhes pas zhabs bsil dbul/ de bzhin du zhabs gsil zhes pa'i gnas su zhabs bsil dang*/ lag pa sngar bzhin las gyen du kha bstan bskor zhing thur du sbub la/ mthe'u chung nas rim par bkrol zhing*/ oṃ hri bi shud+dha sa dharma sarba pa paṃ niṣatsa a s+ya sho dha ya sarba bi kalpā na a pa na ya hūm̐/

zhes pas zhal bsil phul// de bzhin du mchod yon 'di zhes dang*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ zhes pas ar+ghaṃ dbul lo// de nas/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa// bdag gis dad pa 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ bha ga wān sogs dang*/ me tog gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog dang*/ tshal dag ro ni phan pa dang*// gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// spos kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos dang*/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed pa// dge zhing mun pa rnam sel ba// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// mar me'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me dang*/ 'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste// dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// dri'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri dang*/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yi gar 'ong*// sngags kyi zhal zas 'di dag ni// bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// zhal zas kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis bshos dang*/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra shap+da hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos// mi phyed rdo rje'i sku brnyes la// mi phyed mos pas bdag 'bul gyis// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /zhes/ rdo rje khu tshur bsnol ba dang*/ ma bsnol bas stod g.yogs dang*/ smad g.yogs bskon par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra wastā ya āḥhūm̐ gis gos dbul lo// de nas nang mchod sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs la/

mtheb srin sbyar bas dbus nas blangs pa spyi gtsug tu gtor zhing*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mtshan la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la dbul/ de nas dpral ba'i phyogs nas gtor zhing*/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bi la s+ya badz+ra/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ lcam legs smin ka ra/ nag po spyod pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ ga ya dhā ra/ 'brog mi/ se mkhar chung ba/ zhang dgon pa ba/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ ne tso sbal ston/ rta stag so ba rin chen grub/ dpal chu bo ri pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan rnams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la dbul/ de nas bdud rtsi snying ga'i phyogs nas gtor zhing*/ sngar sngags mchod kyi skabs su bstan pa ltar la oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la/ dkyil 'khor dang yi dam gzhan la'ang dbul/ mthar lte ba'i thad nas/ bdud rtsi gtor zhing*/ rdo rje nag po chen po sogs chos skyong rnams la phul nas/ gzhi bdag dang rigs drug sogs kyang lhar gsal la dbul/ de nas yid las byung ba'i mchod pa bya ba'i phyir/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// sogs brjod par bya'o// de nas bla na med pa'i mchod pa bya ba'i phyir/ don dam par/ mchod bya/ mchod yul/ mchod pa rnams rang bzhin gyis ma grub par bsam mo// de nas bstod pa'i mchod par bya ba'i phyir rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /ces pa nas/ shog zhes pa'i bar bha ta ra nyi shu pas bstod par bya'o// de nas rgyun bshags bya ba'i phyir/ thal mo sbyar nas tsog pur 'dug la/ ji srid thog ma med nas 'khor ba nas// zhes sogs sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba'i tshig rnams don yid la dran bzhin pas/ lan gsum bya'o// 'dir gtor ma dbul bar bya ste/ sgrub thabs su bstan pa'i cho gas so// de nas smon lam btab pa ni/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa dang*// sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag

/kye yi rdo rje 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /rigs kyi rjes su ma nyams shing*// dam tshig can dgyes rdo rje 'chang*/ snying rjer ldan zhing bla mar gus// skye zhing skye bar bdag gyur cig /lag na rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni 'don pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar bdag gyur cig /he ru ka dpal bdag gyur nas// sems can rnams kyi don yang byed// he ru ka nyid mchog thob nas// sems can ma lus skye rdor gyur// de ltar bstod pa'i mchog sbyin las// las ni rdo rje'i rigs mchog tu ni bdag myur skye gyur cig /sems can phan phyir yan lag thab kyi yon tan can// 'jam pa'i dbyangs bzhin bdag gyur cig /rnal 'byor ma kun la ni dpe med pa'i// bde ba ster mdzad rdo rje sems dpa' bzhin du bdag gyur cig /phyag rgya drug gi bdag brgyan dur khrod gnas su tshangs pa spyod pa dang ldan bdag gyur cig /ces pa yid la 'dod pa kun smon byar lan bdun bya'o// brgyad pa ni/ cho ga'i lhag chad rnams yi ge brgya pa mang du brjod pas kha bskangs nas/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces bya ba'o// dgu pa ni/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas mthe bong dang*/ srin lag gis se gol dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas maṇ+ḍal gyi lha rnams kyi ye shes pa rnams gshegs shing*/ dam tshig gi lha rnams/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas rang gi snying gar bsdu bar bya'o// bcu pa ni/ me tog rnams mtha' nas dbus su rim par bsdu zhing*/ mchod rdzas rnams kyang bsdu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod pas las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// bgrang yas bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// bsam yas mchod sprin rgya mtshos legs mchod pas// mtha' yas nam mkha'i mthas gtugs sems can rnams// dpag yas rdo rje 'chang dbang nyid gyur cig
